взрослым.analysis: Adjective/noun взрослый ('adult'), m. sg. instr. or pl. dat.; substantivized adjective.

выхода.natural: Of the exit; of the way out.
выхода.analysis: Genitive sg. of выход (m. noun, 'exit, way out'); from выходить.

вернутся.analysis: 3pl future of вернуться (perf., reflexive, 'to return, come back').

ведёте.analysis: 2pl present of вести (impf., 'to lead, conduct, drive'); unidirectional motion verb.

пойдёшь.analysis: 2sg future of пойти (perf., 'to set off on foot'); inchoative of идти.

возьмём.analysis: 1pl future of взять (perf., 'to take'); suppletive perfective of брать.

надёжными.analysis: Adjective надёжный ('reliable'), pl. instr.; from надеяться, 'to rely on'.

доказательствами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of доказательство (n. noun, 'proof, evidence'); from доказать.

едешь.analysis: 2sg present of ехать (impf., 'to go by vehicle'); unidirectional motion verb.

найдёте.analysis: 2pl future of найти (perf., 'to find'); perfective of находить.

кассе.analysis: Prepositional/dative sg. of касса (f. noun, 'cash desk, till, box office').

пошлём.analysis: 1pl future of послать (perf., 'to send'); perfective of посылать.

конференцию.analysis: Accusative sg. of конференция (f. noun, 'conference'); direct-object form.

пройдёт.analysis: 3sg future of пройти (perf., 'to pass, go through'); of time, events, or motion.

сядете.analysis: 2pl future of сесть (perf., 'to sit down, take a seat'); perfective of садиться.

уйди.analysis: 2sg imperative of уйти (perf., 'to leave, go away').

выйду.analysis: 1sg future of выйти (perf., 'to go out, exit'); perfective of выходить.

опоздать.analysis: Infinitive, perf., 'to be late, arrive late'; perfective of опаздывать.

бросит.analysis: 3sg future of бросить (perf., 'to throw; to quit, abandon'); perfective of бросать.

руль.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of руль (m. noun, 'steering wheel, helm, handlebars').

кричу.analysis: 1sg present of кричать (impf., 'to shout, yell, cry out').

молчали.analysis: Past pl. of молчать (impf., 'to be silent, keep quiet').

остановлюсь.analysis: 1sg future of остановиться (perf., reflexive, 'to stop, halt'); в→вл mutation.

оставим.natural: We will leave; we will keep.
оставим.analysis: 1pl future of оставить (perf., 'to leave behind, keep'); perfective of оставлять.

ответят.analysis: 3pl future of ответить (perf., 'to answer, reply'); perfective of отвечать.

дипломы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of диплом (m. noun, 'diploma, degree, certificate').

обещании.analysis: Prepositional sg. of обещание (n. noun, 'promise'); from обещать.

поставим.natural: We will put; we will place.
поставим.analysis: 1pl future of поставить (perf., 'to put, place upright'); perfective of ставить.

появились.analysis: Past pl. of появиться (perf., reflexive, 'to appear, show up'); perfective of появляться.

ненадолго.analysis: Adverb of duration, 'for a short while'; negated form built on надолго.

решат.natural: They will decide; they will solve.
решат.analysis: 3pl future of решить (perf., 'to decide; to solve'); perfective of решать.

спросит.analysis: 3sg future of спросить (perf., 'to ask, inquire'); perfective of спрашивать.

практикой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of практика (f. noun, 'practice, hands-on experience').

уходишь.analysis: 2sg present of уходить (impf., 'to leave, go away on foot').

чудеса.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of чудо (n. noun, 'miracle, wonder'); irregular -еса plural.

пустым.analysis: Adjective пустой ('empty'), m./n. sg. instr. or pl. dat.

пароль.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of пароль (m. noun, 'password, watchword').

заметим.analysis: 1pl future of заметить (perf., 'to notice, remark'); perfective of замечать.

традиции.analysis: Genitive/dative/prep. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of традиция (f. noun, 'tradition, custom').

бывал.analysis: Past m. sg. of бывать (impf., 'to be repeatedly/visit'); frequentative of быть, marking habitual past presence.

чувствовал.analysis: Past m. sg. of чувствовать (impf., 'to feel'); the в in -вств- is silent in pronunciation.

полную.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of полный (adj., 'full/complete'); agrees with a feminine direct object.

имеешь.analysis: 2sg present of иметь (impf., 'to have/possess'); formal; colloquial Russian prefers the у меня есть construction.

ищут.analysis: 3pl present of искать (impf., 'to search/look for'); ск→щ consonant mutation in the present stem.

строгим.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of строгий (adj., 'strict/severe'); often complements verbs like быть/казаться.

казались.analysis: Past pl. of казаться (impf., reflexive, 'to seem/appear'); takes an instrumental complement.

начни.analysis: 2sg imperative of начать (perf., 'to begin'); commands a single completed start.

напишу.analysis: 1sg future of написать (perf., 'to write'); perfective of писать; с→ш mutation in the stem.

мурка.analysis: Nominative sg. of мурка (f. noun), a common affectionate name for a cat, from мурлыкать ('to purr').

называли.analysis: Past pl. of называть (impf., 'to call/name'); imperfective of назвать; takes an instrumental complement.

добрыми.analysis: Instrumental pl. of добрый (adj., 'kind/good'); agrees with a plural complement after verbs like быть.

останься.analysis: 2sg imperative of остаться (perf., reflexive, 'to stay/remain'); commands a single completed act of staying.

оставайся.analysis: 2sg imperative of оставаться (impf., reflexive, 'to stay/remain'); imperfective, urging continued or ongoing staying.

отвечают.analysis: 3pl present of отвечать (impf., 'to answer/reply'); imperfective of ответить; governs dative of person.

диктант.analysis: Nominative sg. of диктант (m. noun, 'dictation'), a written school exercise transcribed from speech.

груз.analysis: Nominative sg. of груз (m. noun, 'load/freight/cargo'); also figurative 'burden'.

приняли.analysis: Past pl. of принять (perf., 'to accept/receive/take'); perfective of принимать.

понимал.analysis: Past m. sg. of понимать (impf., 'to understand'); imperfective, marking ongoing comprehension.

продолжаю.analysis: 1sg present of продолжать (impf., 'to continue'); imperfective of продолжить; often takes an infinitive.

пытаюсь.analysis: 1sg present of пытаться (impf., reflexive, 'to try/attempt'); takes a perfective infinitive.

пытайся.analysis: 2sg imperative of пытаться (impf., reflexive, 'to try/attempt'); urges ongoing effort.

рассказываю.analysis: 1sg present of рассказывать (impf., 'to tell/narrate'); imperfective of рассказать.

никому.analysis: Dative of никто (negative pron., 'no one'); requires a paired negated verb (никому не...).

считай.analysis: 2sg imperative of считать (impf., 'to count/consider'); also a discourse marker 'practically/as good as'.

странную.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of странный (adj., 'strange/odd'); agrees with a feminine direct object.

одежде.analysis: Prepositional/dative sg. of одежда (f. noun, 'clothing'); collective, used in the singular.

слушали.analysis: Past pl. of слушать (impf., 'to listen'); imperfective; governs the accusative.

стану.analysis: 1sg future of стать (perf., 'to become/begin'); also forms the future of imperfectives (стану делать).

успеешь.analysis: 2sg future of успеть (perf., 'to manage in time/be on time'); takes a perfective infinitive.

рейс.analysis: Nominative sg. of рейс (m. noun, 'flight/trip/voyage'); a scheduled transport run.

фронта.analysis: Genitive sg. of фронт (m. noun, 'front', military or meteorological).

рим.analysis: Nominative sg. of Рим (m. proper noun), the city of Rome; capitalized in standard orthography.

встанет.analysis: 3sg future of встать (perf., 'to stand up/get up'); perfective of вставать.

возьмёте.analysis: 2pl future of взять (perf., 'to take'); suppletive perfective of брать.

партнёрами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of партнёр (m. noun, 'partner'); used after с ('with') or as a predicate.

спорной.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of спорный (adj., 'controversial/disputed'), from спор.

поезде.analysis: Prepositional sg. of поезд (m. noun, 'train'); locative form, as in в поезде ('on the train').

найдут.analysis: 3pl future of найти (perf., 'to find'); perfective of находить.

слева.analysis: Adverb of place, 'from/on the left side'; from левый; contrasts with справа.

послал.analysis: Past m. sg. of послать (perf., 'to send'); perfective of посылать.

среду.analysis: Accusative sg. of среда (f. noun); means both 'Wednesday' and 'environment/medium' (distinguished by stress and context).

остановки.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of остановка (f. noun, 'stop', e.g. bus stop), from остановить.

сядут.analysis: 3pl future of сесть (perf., 'to sit down'); perfective of садиться.

войду.analysis: 1sg future of войти (perf., 'to enter/go in'); perfective of входить.

выйдешь.analysis: 2sg future of выйти (perf., 'to go out/exit'); perfective of выходить.

боитесь.analysis: 2pl present of бояться (impf., reflexive, 'to be afraid'); governs the genitive of the feared thing.

бросим.analysis: 1pl future of бросить (perf., 'to throw/abandon/quit'); perfective of бросать.

держим.analysis: 1pl present of держать (impf., 'to hold/keep'); a second-conjugation verb despite the -ать ending.

вдаль.analysis: Adverb of direction, 'far off/into the distance'; from даль; pairs with motion or gaze verbs.

кричишь.analysis: 2sg present of кричать (impf., 'to shout/cry out'); second-conjugation verb.

лежу.analysis: 1sg present of лежать (impf., 'to lie/be in a lying position'); stative position verb.

нахожусь.analysis: 1sg present of находиться (impf., reflexive, 'to be located/situated'); д→ж mutation in 1sg.

остановишься.analysis: 2sg future of остановиться (perf., reflexive, 'to stop/come to a halt'); perfective of останавливаться.

оставите.analysis: 2pl future of оставить (perf., 'to leave/leave behind'); perfective of оставлять.

ответила.analysis: Past f. sg. of ответить (perf., 'to answer'); perfective of отвечать; governs dative of person.

получили.analysis: Past pl. of получить (perf., 'to receive/get'); perfective of получать.

посмотришь.natural: You will look; have a look.
посмотришь.analysis: 2sg future of посмотреть (perf., 'to look/watch'); perfective of смотреть; often takes на + acc.

поставят.analysis: 3pl future of поставить (perf., 'to put/place upright'); perfective of ставить.

появись.analysis: 2sg imperative of появиться (perf., reflexive, 'to appear/show up'); perfective of появляться.

просят.analysis: 3pl present of просить (impf., 'to ask/request'); imperfective of попросить.

трудную.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of трудный (adj., 'difficult/hard'); agrees with a feminine direct object.

спросим.analysis: 1pl future of спросить (perf., 'to ask/inquire'); perfective of спрашивать.

становятся.analysis: 3pl present of становиться (impf., reflexive, 'to become'); takes an instrumental complement.

уходят.analysis: 3pl present of уходить (impf., 'to leave/go away on foot'); imperfective of уйти.

каждому.analysis: Dative m./n. sg. of каждый (determiner/pron., 'each/every'); marks the recipient.

обещаниям.analysis: Dative pl. of обещание (n. noun, 'promise'), from обещать.

вспомни.analysis: 2sg imperative of вспомнить (perf., 'to recall/remember'); perfective of вспоминать.

изменения.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of изменение (n. noun, 'change'), from изменить.

значили.analysis: Past pl. of значить (impf., 'to mean/signify'); imperfective, expressing significance.

здоровая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of здоровый (adj., 'healthy'). Also colloquially 'big/sturdy'.

горло.analysis: Nom./acc. sg. of горло (n. noun, 'throat'). Body part of the neck and gullet.

здоровые.analysis: Nom. pl. of здоровый (adj., 'healthy'). Plural agreement form across all genders.

маленькие.analysis: Nom. pl. of маленький (adj., 'small/little'). Suppletive comparative меньше.

плавают.analysis: 3pl present of плавать (impf., 'to swim/float'); indeterminate motion verb, repeated or general action.

чужая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of чужой (adj., 'another's/alien'). Marks something not one's own.

родная.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of родной (adj., 'native/kindred'). Of family, homeland, or affection.

чёрное.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of чёрный (adj., 'black'). Neuter agreement form.

далёкая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of далёкий (adj., 'distant/far'). Comparative дальше/дальний.

близкое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of близкий (adj., 'close/near'). Comparative ближе.

злой.analysis: Nom. m. sg. of злой (adj., 'angry/evil'). Comparative злее.

злая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of злой (adj., 'angry/evil'). Feminine agreement form.

злые.analysis: Nom. pl. of злой (adj., 'angry/evil'). Plural agreement form.

юбка.analysis: Nom. sg. of юбка (f. noun, 'skirt'). Garment worn from the waist down.

складом.analysis: Instr. sg. of склад (m. noun, 'warehouse/store'). Used after с or as instrument/means.

уродливыми.analysis: Instr. pl. of уродливый (adj., 'ugly/deformed'). Used after с or with instrumental verbs.

прежнего.analysis: Gen./acc. m./n. sg. of прежний (adj., 'former/previous'). Soft-stem adjective.

молодые.analysis: Nom. pl. of молодой (adj., 'young'). Comparative моложе/младше.

внук.analysis: Nom. sg. of внук (m. noun, 'grandson'). Feminine counterpart внучка.

крошечная.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of крошечный (adj., 'tiny'). Diminutive-intensive of small size.

коробке.analysis: Prep./dat. sg. of коробка (f. noun, 'box'). Used after в/на (location) or к (direction).

пуговицы.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. or gen. sg. of пуговица (f. noun, 'button'). Fastener on clothing.

уши.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of ухо (n. noun, 'ear'). Irregular plural; gen. pl. ушей.

полные.analysis: Nom. pl. of полный (adj., 'full/complete'). Also 'plump' of a person.

тарелка.analysis: Nom. sg. of тарелка (f. noun, 'plate'). Tableware for serving food.

пустыми.analysis: Instr. pl. of пустой (adj., 'empty'). Used after с or with instrumental verbs.

полнее.analysis: Comparative of полный (adj., 'full'). Invariant comparative form.

сложное.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of сложный (adj., 'complex/difficult'). Comparative сложнее.

узкий.analysis: Nom. m. sg. of узкий (adj., 'narrow'). Comparative уже.

узкое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of узкий (adj., 'narrow'). Neuter agreement form.

узкие.analysis: Nom. pl. of узкий (adj., 'narrow'). Plural agreement form.

слабое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of слабый (adj., 'weak'). Comparative слабее.

слабого.analysis: Gen./acc. m./n. sg. of слабый (adj., 'weak'). Comparative слабее.

молод.analysis: Short m. sg. of молодой (adj., 'young'). Predicative form ('he is young').

слышны.analysis: Short pl. of слышный (adj., 'audible'). Predicative ('they can be heard').

поведение.analysis: Nom./acc. sg. of поведение (n. noun, 'behavior'). Abstract noun for conduct.

блокнот.analysis: Nom./acc. sg. of блокнот (m. noun, 'notepad'). Small pad for jotting notes.

толстые.analysis: Nom. pl. of толстый (adj., 'thick/fat'). Comparative толще.

ящики.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of ящик (m. noun, 'box/drawer'). Container or pull-out compartment.

платья.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. or gen. sg. of платье (n. noun, 'dress'). Woman's garment.

видны.analysis: Short pl. of видный (adj., 'visible'). Predicative ('they can be seen').

латынь.analysis: Nom./acc. sg. of латынь (f. noun, 'Latin language'). The classical Roman tongue.

мёртвая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of мёртвый (adj., 'dead'). Feminine agreement form.

мёртвое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of мёртвый (adj., 'dead'). Neuter agreement form.

жив.analysis: Short m. sg. of живой (adj., 'alive'). Predicative form ('he is alive').

крепкая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of крепкий (adj., 'strong/sturdy/firm'). Of build, drinks, bonds. Comparative крепче.

здоровое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of здоровый (adj., 'healthy/well'). Of body, lifestyle. Comparative здоровее.

болен.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of больной (adj., 'sick/ill'); predicative, e.g. он болен. F. больна, pl. больны.

того.analysis: Gen./acc. m./n. sg. of тот (demonstrative pron., 'that'). Marks possession or animate object.

медленные.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of медленный (adj., 'slow'). Comparative медленнее; adverb медленно.

родное.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of родной (adj., 'native/own/dear'). Of homeland, family, language.

чужом.analysis: Prep. m./n. sg. of чужой (adj., 'someone else's/foreign'). E.g. в чужом доме.

белое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of белый (adj., 'white'). Of color, e.g. белое вино.

близкая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of близкий (adj., 'close/near'). Of distance or relationships. Comparative ближе.

севере.analysis: Prep. sg. of север (m. noun, 'north'). Locative use, e.g. на севере.

пёс.analysis: Nom. sg. of пёс (m. noun, 'dog', often male/big). Colloquial alongside собака.

злое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of злой (adj., 'angry/evil/mean'). Comparative злее.

короткие.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of короткий (adj., 'short'). Of length/duration. Comparative короче.

уродливая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of уродливый (adj., 'ugly/deformed'). Comparative уродливее.

уродливый.analysis: Nom. m. sg. of уродливый (adj., 'ugly/deformed'). Comparative уродливее.

пейзаж.analysis: Nom./acc. sg. of пейзаж (m. noun, 'landscape/scenery'). Of nature or painting genre.

молодое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of молодой (adj., 'young'). Comparative моложе/младше.

спортсмены.analysis: Nom. pl. of спортсмен (m. noun, 'athlete/sportsman'). Animate; f. спортсменка.

гуляют.analysis: 3pl present of гулять (impf., 'to stroll/take a walk'). Leisurely walking, not goal-directed.

крошечный.analysis: Nom. m. sg. of крошечный (adj., 'tiny/minuscule'). Emphatic diminutive of small.

крошечные.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of крошечный (adj., 'tiny/minuscule'). Emphatic diminutive of small.

двоих.analysis: Gen./acc. of двое (collective numeral, 'two', of people/young/paired things). E.g. двоих детей.

мыши.analysis: Nom. pl. or gen./dat./prep. sg. of мышь (f. noun, 'mouse'). Animal or computer device.

карманы.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of карман (m. noun, 'pocket'). Of clothing or figurative funds.

залы.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of зал (m. noun, 'hall/large room'). Of concert, exhibition, gym.

полон.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of полный (adj., 'full'); predicative, e.g. зал полон. F. полна, pl. полны.

простая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of простой (adj., 'simple/easy/plain'). Comparative проще.

простые.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of простой (adj., 'simple/easy/plain'). Comparative проще.

узкая.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of узкий (adj., 'narrow'). Comparative уже.

неудобное.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of неудобный (adj., 'uncomfortable/inconvenient'). Negation of удобный.

шире.analysis: Comparative of широкий (adj., 'wide') / широко (adv.). E.g. эта дорога шире.

игрок.analysis: Nom. sg. of игрок (m. noun, 'player/gambler'). Animate; of games or sport.

аргументы.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of аргумент (m. noun, 'argument/point in reasoning'). Not a quarrel.

силён.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of сильный (adj., 'strong'); predicative, e.g. он силён. F. сильна, pl. сильны.

звуки.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of звук (m. noun, 'sound'). Of noise, music, phonetics.

страннее.analysis: Comparative of странный (adj., 'strange') / странно (adv.). E.g. это ещё страннее.

толстое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of толстый (adj., 'thick/fat'). Comparative толще.

дерева.analysis: Gen. sg. of дерево (n. noun, 'tree/wood'). E.g. из дерева ('made of wood').

висят.analysis: 3pl present of висеть (impf., 'to hang/be suspended'). Stative; subject is what hangs.

тяжелее.analysis: Comparative of тяжёлый (adj., 'heavy/hard') / тяжело (adv.). E.g. этот груз тяжелее.

низкие.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of низкий (adj., 'low/short'). Comparative ниже.

мёртвый.analysis: Nom. m. sg. of мёртвый (adj., 'dead'). Of beings or figurative (dead silence).

живое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of живой (adj., 'alive/living/lively'). Of beings or vivid quality.

живые.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of живой (adj., 'alive/living/lively'). Of beings or vivid quality.

больное.analysis: Adjective больной ('sick, ill, sore') in n. sg. nom./acc. Describes a painful or diseased thing.

больные.analysis: Adjective больной ('sick, ill') in pl. nom. Can also be substantivized as a noun meaning 'patients'.

полю.analysis: Dative sg. of поле (n. noun, 'field'). Indirect-object/direction form; nominative -е becomes -ю.

быстрые.analysis: Adjective быстрый ('fast, quick') in pl. nom. Comparative быстрее; related adverb быстро.

обычного.analysis: Adjective обычный ('usual, ordinary') in m./n. sg. gen. Marks possession or absence of the typical thing.

родные.analysis: Adjective родной ('native, kindred, dear') in pl. nom. Often substantivized as 'relatives, kin'.

чёрная.analysis: Adjective чёрный ('black') in f. sg. nom. Agrees with a feminine noun.

чёрные.analysis: Adjective чёрный ('black') in pl. nom. Agrees with a plural noun.

далёкое.analysis: Adjective далёкий ('distant, far') in n. sg. nom./acc. Comparative дальше/далее.

близкие.analysis: Adjective близкий ('close, near, intimate') in pl. nom. Comparative ближе. Often substantivized as 'loved ones'.

учительница.analysis: Nominative sg. of учительница (f. noun, 'female teacher'); feminine counterpart of учитель.

замечание.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of замечание (n. noun, 'remark, comment, reprimand').

карандаши.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of карандаш (m. noun, 'pencil'); stem-stressed ending -и.

уродливым.analysis: Adjective уродливый ('ugly, deformed') in m./n. sg. instr. or pl. dat. Marks means or recipient.

здания.analysis: Of здание (n. noun, 'building'): gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. Ending -ия from soft-stem neuter.

красивее.analysis: Comparative of красивый ('beautiful'); indeclinable form used predicatively or with adverbial sense.

поколение.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of поколение (n. noun, 'generation'); soft-stem neuter in -ие.

тренируются.analysis: 3pl present of тренироваться (impf., reflexive, 'to train, practice'); -ся marks the reflexive.

молода.analysis: Short-form f. sg. of молодой ('young'); predicative, e.g. она молода.

огромные.analysis: Adjective огромный ('huge, enormous') in pl. nom. Intensified synonym of большой.

красные.analysis: Adjective красный ('red') in pl. nom. Agrees with a plural noun.

слона.analysis: Gen./acc. sg. of слон (m. animate noun, 'elephant'); animate accusative equals genitive.

пустое.analysis: Adjective пустой ('empty, vacant') in n. sg. nom./acc. Short form пуст; comparative пустее.

конфет.analysis: Genitive pl. of конфета (f. noun, 'candy, sweet'); zero-ending plural form, e.g. after много.

музея.analysis: Genitive sg. of музей (m. noun, 'museum'); soft-stem ending -я marks possession or 'from'.

пуст.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of пустой ('empty'); predicative, e.g. дом пуст.

простое.analysis: Adjective простой ('simple, plain, easy') in n. sg. nom./acc. Comparative проще.

сложнее.analysis: Comparative of сложный ('complex, difficult'); indeclinable, used predicatively or adverbially.

широкое.analysis: Adjective широкий ('wide, broad') in n. sg. nom./acc. Comparative шире.

поля.analysis: Of поле (n. noun, 'field'): gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. Stem-stressed plural поля.

слабая.analysis: Adjective слабый ('weak, faint') in f. sg. nom. Comparative слабее; short form слаба.

победил.analysis: Past m. sg. of победить (perf., 'to win, defeat'); completed act, perfective of побеждать.

слабыми.analysis: Adjective слабый ('weak') in pl. instr. Marks means or accompaniment; comparative слабее.

обычные.analysis: Adjective обычный ('usual, ordinary') in pl. nom. Agrees with a plural noun.

ошибка.analysis: Nominative sg. of ошибка (f. noun, 'mistake, error'); root in ошибаться 'to err'.

одеяло.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of одеяло (n. noun, 'blanket, quilt').

ветки.analysis: Of ветка (f. noun, 'branch, twig'): gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. Diminutive of ветвь.

лёгкие.analysis: Adjective лёгкий ('light, easy') in pl. nom. Comparative легче. Also a noun meaning 'lungs'.

коробка.analysis: Nominative sg. of коробка (f. noun, 'box, carton').

ниже.analysis: Comparative of низкий ('low'); also adverb 'below, further down'. Indeclinable.

роза.analysis: Nominative sg. of роза (f. noun, 'rose'); the flower.

существо.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of существо (n. noun, 'creature, living being; essence').

мёртвые.analysis: Adjective мёртвый ('dead, lifeless') in pl. nom. Short form мёртв. Often substantivized as 'the dead'.

редкая.analysis: Adjective, nom. f. sg. of редкий ('rare/infrequent/sparse'). Comparative реже.

частые.analysis: Adjective, nom. pl. of частый ('frequent/dense'). Comparative чаще.

дожди.analysis: Nominative pl. of дождь (m. noun, 'rain'). Plural denotes repeated or spells of rain.

редки.analysis: Short-form pl. of редкий ('rare'); predicative, asserting rarity. Cf. long form редкие.

зимние.analysis: Adjective, nom. pl. of зимний ('winter, of winter'). Soft-stem relational adjective from зима.

миг.analysis: Nominative sg. of миг (m. noun, 'instant/moment'). Denotes a very brief span of time.

разговоры.analysis: Nominative pl. of разговор (m. noun, 'conversation/talk'). From раз- + говорить.

краток.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of краткий ('brief/concise'); predicative. Cf. comparative короче.

ручей.analysis: Nominative sg. of ручей (m. noun, 'brook/stream'). A small flowing watercourse.

озеро.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of озеро (n. noun, 'lake'). Pl. озёра with ё.

надёжнее.analysis: Comparative of надёжный ('reliable/dependable') / adverb надёжно. Means more dependable.

неглубокий.analysis: Adjective, m. sg. of неглубокий ('shallow'); negated form of глубокий. Comparative мельче/неглубже.

глубокими.analysis: Adjective, instr. pl. of глубокий ('deep'). Comparative глубже.

глубже.analysis: Comparative of глубокий ('deep') / adverb глубоко. Means to a greater depth.

кастрюли.analysis: Nom. pl. or gen. sg. of кастрюля (f. noun, 'pot/saucepan'). Cooking vessel.

холодными.analysis: Adjective, instr. pl. of холодный ('cold'). Comparative холоднее.

мелкие.analysis: Adjective, nom. pl. of мелкий ('small/shallow/fine'). Comparative мельче.

мелкая.analysis: Adjective, nom. f. sg. of мелкий ('small/shallow/fine'). Comparative мельче.

корзине.analysis: Prep./dat. sg. of корзина (f. noun, 'basket'). E.g. в корзине ('in the basket').

тупой.analysis: Adjective, m. sg. of тупой ('blunt/dull'; of a person, 'dim'). Comparative тупее.

тупое.analysis: Adjective, nom./acc. n. sg. of тупой ('blunt/dull'). Comparative тупее.

тупого.analysis: Adjective, gen./acc. m. sg. of тупой ('blunt/dull'). Comparative тупее.

задавай.analysis: Imperative 2sg of задавать (impf., 'to set/pose'). E.g. задавай вопрос ('ask a question').

закрытая.analysis: Past passive participle, nom. f. sg. of закрыть ('to close'); adjectival 'closed'.

закрытый.analysis: Past passive participle, m. sg. of закрыть ('to close'); adjectival 'closed'.

закрытой.analysis: Past passive participle of закрыть, gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. ('closed').

левые.analysis: Adjective, nom. pl. of левый ('left, left-hand'; politically 'leftist').

повернись.analysis: Imperative 2sg of повернуться (perf., reflexive, 'to turn'). Cf. impf. поворачиваться.

правому.analysis: Adjective, dat. m./n. sg. of правый ('right, right-hand'; politically 'right-wing').

кривое.analysis: Adjective, nom./acc. n. sg. of кривой ('crooked/curved/bent').

пряма.analysis: Short-form f. sg. of прямой ('straight/direct'); predicative. Cf. long form прямая.

несчастная.analysis: Adjective, nom. f. sg. of несчастный ('unhappy/unfortunate'). Negated счастный.

несчастному.analysis: Adjective, dat. m./n. sg. of несчастный ('unhappy/unfortunate').

аварии.analysis: Gen./dat./prep. sg. or nom. pl. of авария (f. noun, 'accident/breakdown/crash').

счастливее.analysis: Comparative of счастливый ('happy') / adverb счастливо. Means more fortunate or happy.

учатся.analysis: 3pl present of учиться (impf., reflexive, 'to study/learn'). Subject learns or attends school.

младшему.analysis: Adjective, dat. m./n. sg. of младший ('younger/junior'); comparative/superlative of молодой.

малышами.analysis: Instr. pl. of малыш (m. noun, 'baby/toddler/little one'). Affectionate term for small children.

младшим.analysis: Adjective, instr. m./n. sg. or dat. pl. of младший ('younger/junior').

мокрые.analysis: Adjective, nom. pl. of мокрый ('wet'). Comparative мокрее.

носки.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of носок (m. noun, 'sock'). Also gen. sg. of нос ('nose, toe').

сухими.analysis: Adjective, instr. pl. of сухой ('dry'). Comparative суше.

сух.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of сухой ('dry'); predicative. Cf. comparative суше.

машин.analysis: Genitive pl. of машина (f. noun, 'car/machine'). E.g. много машин ('many cars').

тихим.analysis: Adjective, instr. m./n. sg. or dat. pl. of тихий ('quiet/calm'). Comparative тише.

весёлый.analysis: Adjective, m. sg. of весёлый ('cheerful/merry'). Comparative веселее.

грустные.analysis: Adjective, nom. pl. of грустный ('sad'). Comparative грустнее.

грустный.analysis: Adjective, m. sg. of грустный ('sad'). Comparative грустнее.

грустен.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of грустный ('sad'); predicative. Cf. f. грустна.

явление.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of явление (n. noun, 'phenomenon, occurrence'); from являться.

головные.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of головной (relational adj. from голова, 'head'), e.g. головные боли 'headaches'.

редкие.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of редкий (adj., 'rare, infrequent, sparse').

реже.analysis: Comparative of редкий/редко (adj./adv., 'rare/rarely'); consonant alternation д→ж.

краткий.analysis: Adjective краткий (m. sg., 'brief, short, concise'); comparative короче.

долгими.analysis: Instrumental pl. of долгий (adj., 'long' in time/duration).

точен.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of точный (adj., 'precise, exact, accurate').

неглубокая.analysis: Nominative f. sg. of неглубокий (adj., 'shallow, not deep'); negated глубокий.

неглубокие.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of неглубокий (adj., 'shallow, not deep'); negated глубокий.

неглубокого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of неглубокий (adj., 'shallow, not deep').

глубокой.analysis: Gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. of глубокий (adj., 'deep'); comparative глубже.

неглубока.analysis: Short-form f. sg. of неглубокий (adj., 'shallow, not deep'); negated глубокий.

плите.analysis: Dat./prep. sg. of плита (f. noun, 'stove, cooktop; slab').

горячим.analysis: Instr. m./n. sg. or dat. pl. of горячий (adj., 'hot' to the touch).

горячее.analysis: Comparative of горячий/горячо ('hot/hotly'); also nom./acc. n. sg. of горячий.

крупная.analysis: Nominative f. sg. of крупный (adj., 'large, big, coarse-grained, major').

сменился.analysis: Past m. sg. of смениться (perf., reflexive, 'to be replaced, give way to').

крупные.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of крупный (adj., 'large, big, coarse-grained, major').

повара.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. (or nom. pl. повара́) of повар (m. noun, 'cook, chef').

острые.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of острый (adj., 'sharp; spicy'); comparative острее.

лезвие.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of лезвие (n. noun, 'blade, cutting edge').

острая.analysis: Nominative f. sg. of острый (adj., 'sharp; spicy, pungent'); comparative острее.

тупые.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of тупой (adj., 'blunt, dull; obtuse').

открытое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of открытый (adj./past pass. part. of открыть, 'open, opened').

открытую.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of открытый (adj./past pass. part. of открыть, 'open, opened').

открытыми.analysis: Instrumental pl. of открытый (adj./past pass. part. of открыть, 'open, opened').

открываются.analysis: 3pl present of открываться (impf., reflexive, 'to open, be opened').

правом.analysis: Prep. m./n. sg. of правый (adj., 'right-hand'); also prep. sg. of право (n. noun, 'right').

кривая.analysis: Nominative f. sg. of кривой (adj., 'crooked, curved'); nominalized as 'curve'.

крыльцо.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of крыльцо (n. noun, 'porch, front steps').

доски.analysis: Genitive sg. or nom./acc. pl. of доска (f. noun, 'board, plank; board/blackboard').

тропинки.analysis: Genitive sg. or nom./acc. pl. of тропинка (f. noun, 'path, trail'); diminutive of тропа.

счастливое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of счастливый (adj., 'happy, fortunate').

счастлив.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of счастливый (adj., 'happy'); predicative, e.g. я счастлив.

несчастным.analysis: Instr. m./n. sg. or dat. pl. of несчастный (adj., 'unhappy, miserable'); negated счастливый.

младшие.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of младший (adj., 'younger, junior'); comparative/superlative of молодой.

старшее.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of старший (adj., 'older, elder, senior').

старшие.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of старший (adj., 'older, elder, senior').

любознательна.analysis: Short-form f. sg. of любознательный (adj., 'inquisitive, eager to learn').

мокрая.analysis: Nominative f. sg. of мокрый (adj., 'wet, soaked').

мокрое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of мокрый (adj., 'wet, soaked').

мокрой.analysis: Gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. of мокрый (adj., 'wet, soaked').

лёгкими.analysis: Instrumental pl. of лёгкий (adj., 'light in weight; easy'); comparative легче.

разбудил.analysis: Past m. sg. of разбудить (perf., 'to wake someone'); perfective of будить.

аплодисменты.analysis: Nom./acc. of аплодисменты (m. noun, plurale tantum, 'applause, clapping').

грустная.analysis: Nominative f. sg. of грустный (adj., 'sad, mournful'); comparative грустнее.

утешил.analysis: Past m. sg. of утешить (perf., 'to comfort, console'); perfective of утешать.

весёлой.analysis: Gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. of весёлый (adj., 'cheerful, merry'); comparative веселее.

вечеринке.analysis: Dat./prep. sg. of вечеринка (f. noun, 'party, social gathering').

природе.analysis: Prepositional/dative sg. of природа (f. noun, 'nature'); locative 'in nature' after на/в or dative after к.

редкими.analysis: Instrumental pl. of редкий (adj., 'rare/infrequent'); agrees with a plural instrumental noun.

визиты.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of визит (m. noun, 'visit'); plural ending -ы.

краткая.analysis: Feminine sg. nominative of краткий (adj., 'brief/concise'); agrees with a f. noun.

отдых.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of отдых (m. noun, 'rest, recreation'); often a holiday or break.

краткой.analysis: Feminine sg. genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional of краткий (adj., 'brief'); oblique f. form.

тёплыми.analysis: Instrumental pl. of тёплый (adj., 'warm'); agrees with a plural instrumental noun.

путешествие.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of путешествие (n. noun, 'journey, voyage'); ending -ие.

глубокое.analysis: Neuter sg. nominative/accusative of глубокий (adj., 'deep'); agrees with a n. noun.

лужи.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of лужа (f. noun, 'puddle'); ending -и.

пруд.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of пруд (m. noun, 'pond'); small body of still water.

знания.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of знание (n. noun, 'knowledge'); ending -ия.

середине.analysis: Prepositional/dative sg. of середина (f. noun, 'middle'); locative 'in the middle' after в.

горячие.analysis: Plural nominative/accusative of горячий (adj., 'hot' to the touch); agrees with a pl. noun.

напитки.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of напиток (m. noun, 'drink, beverage'); plural ending -и.

пляже.analysis: Prepositional sg. of пляж (m. noun, 'beach'); locative 'on the beach' after на.

крупное.analysis: Neuter sg. nominative/accusative of крупный (adj., 'large, sizeable'); agrees with a n. noun.

мелким.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of мелкий (adj., 'small/fine/shallow'); oblique form.

шрифт.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of шрифт (m. noun, 'font, type'); printed lettering style.

карандаш.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of карандаш (m. noun, 'pencil'); ends in soft -ш.

когти.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of коготь (m. noun, 'claw, talon'); plural with stem -т-.

режет.analysis: 3sg present of резать (impf., 'to cut'); stem alternation з→ж before -ет.

корейская.analysis: Feminine sg. nominative of корейский (adj., 'Korean'); agrees with a f. noun.

острее.analysis: Comparative of острый (adj., 'sharp'); also 'spicier'. Means 'more sharp'.

закрытые.analysis: Plural nominative/accusative of закрытый (past-passive participle/adj., 'closed, shut'); agrees with pl. noun.

касса.analysis: Nominative sg. of касса (f. noun, 'cash register, ticket office, checkout'); ending -а.

левой.analysis: Feminine sg. genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional of левый (adj., 'left'); oblique f. form.

вилку.analysis: Accusative sg. of вилка (f. noun, 'fork'); direct-object form, -а becomes -у.

ложка.analysis: Nominative sg. of ложка (f. noun, 'spoon'); ending -а.

забора.analysis: Genitive sg. of забор (m. noun, 'fence'); possessive/'of the fence' form.

прямая.analysis: Feminine sg. nominative of прямой (adj., 'straight, direct'); agrees with a f. noun.

честный.analysis: Masculine sg. nominative of честный (adj., 'honest'); silent т in pronunciation.

прежней.analysis: Feminine sg. genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional of прежний (adj., 'former, previous'); oblique f. form.

счастливые.analysis: Plural nominative/accusative of счастливый (adj., 'happy'); agrees with a pl. noun.

свадьбе.analysis: Prepositional/dative sg. of свадьба (f. noun, 'wedding'); locative 'at the wedding' after на.

несчастными.analysis: Instrumental pl. of несчастный (adj., 'unhappy, miserable'); agrees with a pl. instrumental noun.

классы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of класс (m. noun, 'class, grade, classroom'); plural ending -ы.

войну.analysis: Accusative sg. of война (f. noun, 'war'); direct-object form, -а becomes -у.

советуют.analysis: 3pl present of советовать (impf., 'to advise'); takes dative of person advised.

сухое.analysis: Neuter sg. nominative/accusative of сухой (adj., 'dry'); agrees with a n. noun.

сухие.analysis: Plural nominative/accusative of сухой (adj., 'dry'); agrees with a pl. noun.

скользкой.analysis: Feminine sg. genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional of скользкий (adj., 'slippery'); oblique f. form.

промок.analysis: Past m. sg. of промокнуть (perf., 'to get soaked through'); describes a m. subject becoming wet.

громкие.analysis: Plural nominative/accusative of громкий (adj., 'loud'); agrees with a pl. noun.

тихого.analysis: Masculine/neuter sg. genitive/accusative of тихий (adj., 'quiet, soft'); oblique m./n. form.

громкими.analysis: Instrumental pl. of громкий (adj., 'loud'); agrees with a pl. instrumental noun.

весёлое.analysis: Neuter sg. nominative/accusative of весёлый (adj., 'cheerful, merry'); agrees with a n. noun.

грустную.analysis: Feminine sg. accusative of грустный (adj., 'sad'); direct-object f. form.

грустными.analysis: Instrumental pl. of грустный (adj., 'sad'); agrees with a pl. instrumental noun.

веселее.analysis: Comparative of весёлый (adj., 'cheerful'); also adverbial 'more merrily'. Means 'more cheerful'.

навещаю.analysis: 1sg present of навещать (impf., 'to visit/call on someone'); paired perfective навестить.

деде.analysis: Prepositional sg. of дед (m. noun, 'grandfather'); used after о, в, на.

дядей.analysis: Instrumental sg. of дядя (m. noun, 'uncle'); soft-stem ending -ей.

папе.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of папа (m. noun, 'dad'); declines like a fem. noun in -а.

древнему.analysis: Dative m./n. sg. of древний (adj., 'ancient/old'); soft-stem agreement.

родителям.analysis: Dative pl. of родитель (m. noun, 'parent'); typically used in plural for 'parents'.

сыном.analysis: Instrumental sg. of сын (m. noun, 'son'); irregular plural сыновья.

жёны.analysis: Nominative pl. (or genitive sg.) of жена (f. noun, 'wife'); ё in stressed plural stem.

пустые.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of пустой (adj., 'empty/vacant'); also figurative 'meaningless'.

масло.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of масло (n. noun, 'butter/oil'); covers cooking oil and dairy butter.

рыбак.analysis: Nominative sg. of рыбак (m. noun, 'fisherman'); from рыба ('fish').

стаканы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of стакан (m. noun, 'drinking glass/tumbler').

растения.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. (or genitive sg.) of растение (n. noun, 'plant').

зацвёл.analysis: Past m. sg. of зацвести (perf., 'to start blooming'); inceptive за- prefix on цвести.

ягоды.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. (or genitive sg.) of ягода (f. noun, 'berry').

жар.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of жар (m. noun, 'heat/fever'); intense warmth or body temperature.

концу.analysis: Dative sg. of конец (m. noun, 'end'); fleeting vowel drops in oblique cases.

секундой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of секунда (f. noun, 'second' of time).

сутками.analysis: Instrumental pl. of сутки (plurale tantum noun, '24-hour day/day-and-night').

летние.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of летний (adj., 'summer'); from лето.

возрастах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of возраст (m. noun, 'age'); span of a person's years.

гавани.analysis: Genitive/dative/prepositional sg. or nominative pl. of гавань (f. noun, 'harbor/haven').

самолёта.analysis: Genitive sg. of самолёт (m. noun, 'airplane'); literally 'self-flyer'.

деньгами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of деньги (plurale tantum noun, 'money'); no singular sense.

расходятся.analysis: 3pl present of расходиться (impf., 'to disperse/part'); reflexive, paired perfective разойтись.

целого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of целый (adj., 'whole/entire'); as noun 'the whole'.

десятки.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of десяток (m. noun, 'group of ten'); fleeting vowel in plural.

дались.analysis: Past pl. of даться (perf., 'to come/yield to someone'); reflexive, of skills coming easily.

метру.analysis: Dative sg. of метр (m. noun, 'meter', unit of length).

следит.analysis: 3sg present of следить (impf., 'to watch/keep track'); governs за + instrumental.

вступил.analysis: Past m. sg. of вступить (perf., 'to enter/join'); paired imperfective вступать.

рубли.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of рубль (m. noun, 'ruble', Russian currency).

матча.analysis: Genitive sg. of матч (m. noun, 'match/game', sports contest).

изо.analysis: Preposition, variant of из ('out of/from') used before certain consonant clusters; governs genitive.

полезных.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of полезный (adj., 'useful/beneficial'); from польза.

труды.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of труд (m. noun, 'labor/work'); plural often 'scholarly works'.

тысячи.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of тысяча (f. noun/numeral, 'thousand').

бабушку.analysis: Accusative sg. of бабушка (f. noun, 'grandmother'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

деды.analysis: Nominative pl. of дед (m. noun, 'grandfather'); plural also connotes ancestors/forefathers.

мамой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of мама (f. noun, 'mom'); used with с ('with mom') or as the by-whom agent.

муже.analysis: Prepositional sg. of муж (m. noun, 'husband'); appears after о/в, as in о муже ('about the husband').

папой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of папа (m. noun, 'dad'); declines like a fem. noun despite masculine gender.

роду.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of род (m. noun, 'kin/genus/gender'); also fixed в роду ('in the family line').

родителем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of родитель (m. noun, 'parent'); by-whom/with-whom form.

сыне.analysis: Prepositional sg. of сын (m. noun, 'son'); appears after о/в, as in о сыне ('about the son').

приготовила.analysis: Past f. sg. of приготовить (perf., 'to prepare/cook'); perfective of готовить, marking a completed act.

бутылок.analysis: Genitive pl. of бутылка (f. noun, 'bottle'); fleeting vowel inserted: -лка becomes -лок.

хлебу.analysis: Dative sg. of хлеб (m. noun, 'bread'); recipient/direction form, as in к хлебу ('toward the bread').

поймал.analysis: Past m. sg. of поймать (perf., 'to catch'); perfective of ловить, marking a single completed catch.

сок.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of сок (m. noun, 'juice'); inanimate, so accusative equals nominative.

вином.analysis: Instrumental sg. of вино (n. noun, 'wine'); with-what/by-what form.

вкусная.analysis: Adjective вкусный 'tasty' (f. sg. nom.); agrees with a feminine noun. Comparative вкуснее.

любовались.analysis: Past pl. of любоваться (impf., reflexive, 'to admire'); takes instrumental object.

деревьев.analysis: Genitive pl. of дерево (n. noun, 'tree'); irregular plural stem дерев- with -ьев ending.

дождях.analysis: Prepositional pl. of дождь (m. noun, 'rain'); appears after о/в, as in о дождях ('about the rains').

мешал.analysis: Past m. sg. of мешать (impf., 'to hinder' with dat., or 'to stir' with acc.); aspect imperfective.

альпинисты.analysis: Nominative pl. of альпинист (m. noun, 'mountaineer/climber'); animate masculine.

края.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative pl. of край (m. noun, 'edge/region/territory'); context disambiguates.

садовник.analysis: Nominative sg. of садовник (m. noun, 'gardener'); animate masculine, derived from сад ('garden').

густые.analysis: Adjective густой 'thick/dense' (pl. nom.); of foliage, hair, fog. Comparative гуще.

небу.analysis: Dative sg. of небо (n. noun, 'sky'); direction/recipient form, as in по небу ('across the sky').

тёплому.analysis: Adjective тёплый 'warm' (m./n. sg. dat.); agrees with a dative masc./neut. noun. Comparative теплее.

маяк.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of маяк (m. noun, 'lighthouse'); inanimate, so accusative equals nominative.

природы.analysis: Genitive sg. of природа (f. noun, 'nature'); of-form, as in красота природы ('beauty of nature').

впадают.analysis: 3pl present of впадать (impf., 'to flow into'); of rivers, with в + acc. Perfective впасть.

тянутся.analysis: 3pl present of тянуться (impf., reflexive, 'to stretch/extend'); of landscapes or time.

залита.analysis: Short past passive participle (f. sg.) of залить (perf., 'to flood/pour over'); залита светом ('bathed in light').

траву.analysis: Accusative sg. of трава (f. noun, 'grass'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

пчела.analysis: Nominative sg. of пчела (f. noun, 'bee'); animate feminine.

качается.analysis: 3sg present of качаться (impf., reflexive, 'to sway/rock'); intransitive motion back and forth.

дышим.analysis: 1pl present of дышать (impf., 'to breathe'); second-conjugation verb.

принадлежат.analysis: 3pl present of принадлежать (impf., 'to belong'); takes dative of owner.

сибирские.analysis: Relative adjective сибирский 'Siberian' (pl. nom.); derived from Сибирь ('Siberia').

известной.analysis: Adjective известный 'famous' (f. sg. gen./dat./instr./prep.); agrees with a feminine noun. Comparative известнее.

фермер.analysis: Nominative sg. of фермер (m. noun, 'farmer'); animate masculine, a borrowing from English.

редкой.analysis: Adjective редкий 'rare/sparse' (f. sg. gen./dat./instr./prep.); agrees with a feminine noun. Comparative реже.

холодает.analysis: 3sg present of холодать (impf., 'to grow cold'); impersonal weather verb. Perfective похолодать.

готовятся.analysis: 3pl present of готовиться (impf., reflexive, 'to get ready'); takes к + dat.

тёплом.analysis: Adjective тёплый 'warm' (m./n. sg. prep.); agrees with a prepositional masc./neut. noun. Comparative теплее.

месяцев.analysis: Genitive pl. of месяц (m. noun, 'month'); counting form, as in пять месяцев ('five months').

неделей.analysis: Instrumental sg. of неделя (f. noun, 'week'); with-what/by-what form.

секунде.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of секунда (f. noun, 'second' of time); recipient or after-о form.

сутках.analysis: Prepositional of сутки (pl.-only noun, 'a 24-hour day'); appears in в сутках ('in a day').

наступил.analysis: Past m. sg. of наступить (perf., 'to set in/arrive', of time/season); also 'to step on'. Imperfective наступать.

развивается.analysis: 3sg present of развиваться (impf., reflexive, 'to develop'); intransitive growth/progress.

порту.analysis: Prepositional sg. of порт (m. noun, 'port'); locative -у ending, as in в порту ('in the port').

корабли.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of корабль (m. noun, 'ship'); inanimate, so accusative equals nominative.

пассажиры.analysis: Nominative pl. of пассажир (m. noun, 'passenger'); animate masculine.

банком.analysis: Instrumental sg. of банк (m. noun, 'bank', financial); with-what/by-what form.

делом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of дело (n. noun, 'affair/business/deed'); also fixed в самом деле ('in fact').

десятка.analysis: Genitive sg. of десяток (m. noun, 'a set of ten') or nom. of colloquial десятка ('a ten'); fleeting vowel dropped.

пробежал.analysis: Past m. sg. of пробежать (perf., 'to run a distance/run past'); perfective with prefix про-.

основал.analysis: Past m. sg. of основать (perf., 'to found/establish'); imperfective основывать.

квадратном.analysis: Adjective квадратный 'square' (m./n. sg. prep.); agrees with a prepositional masc./neut. noun.

очередью.analysis: Instrumental sg. of очередь (f. noun, 'queue/turn'); with-what form, as in в свою очередь ('in turn').

приказы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of приказ (m. noun, 'order/command'); inanimate, accusative equals nominative.

сувенир.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of сувенир (m. noun, 'souvenir'); inanimate, accusative equals nominative.

счета.analysis: Genitive sg. of счёт (m. noun, 'account/bill/score'); ё-less spelling of the inflected form.

сил.analysis: Genitive pl. of сила (f. noun, 'strength/force'); counting/quantity form, as in нет сил ('no strength').

служб.analysis: Genitive pl. of служба (f. noun, 'service/duty'); of-form for multiple agencies or church services.

напрасны.analysis: Short-form adjective (pl.) of напрасный 'futile/vain'; predicative, as in усилия напрасны ('efforts are in vain').

тысяче.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of тысяча (f. numeral noun, 'thousand'); recipient or after-о form.

бабушкой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of бабушка (f. noun, 'grandmother'); the -ой ending marks accompaniment or means.

воевали.analysis: Past pl. of воевать (impf., 'to wage war, fight'); plural agreement, ongoing or repeated combat.

дружат.analysis: 3pl present of дружить (impf., 'to be friends'); second-conjugation, denotes an ongoing friendship.

мужья.analysis: Nominative pl. of муж (m. noun, 'husband'); irregular plural with stem extension -ья.

велосипед.analysis: Nominative sg. of велосипед (m. noun, 'bicycle'); inanimate, regular hard-stem declension.

гордится.analysis: 3sg present of гордиться (impf., reflexive, 'to be proud of'); governs instrumental of its object.

моих.analysis: Genitive/prepositional/accusative-animate pl. of мой (possessive pronoun, 'my'); agrees with plural noun.

сыновья.analysis: Nominative pl. of сын (m. noun, 'son'); irregular plural with stem extension -овья.

бутылку.analysis: Accusative sg. of бутылка (f. noun, 'bottle'); direct-object form, nominative -а becomes -у.

сахар.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of сахар (m. noun, 'sugar'); inanimate mass noun, hard-stem.

готовим.analysis: 1pl present of готовить (impf., 'to cook, prepare'); second-conjugation with -в- stem.

рыб.analysis: Genitive pl. of рыба (f. noun, 'fish'); zero-ending form used after numbers or for quantity.

курит.analysis: 3sg present of курить (impf., 'to smoke'); second-conjugation, habitual or ongoing action.

заказал.analysis: Past m. sg. of заказать (perf., 'to order'); perfective of заказывать, a completed order.

водку.analysis: Accusative sg. of водка (f. noun, 'vodka'); direct-object form, nominative -а becomes -у.

крутым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of крутой (adj., 'steep; sheer; slang cool'); agrees with its noun.

теряют.analysis: 3pl present of терять (impf., 'to lose'); first-conjugation, ongoing or repeated action.

дыма.analysis: Genitive sg. of дым (m. noun, 'smoke'); marks absence, quantity, or possession.

вдали.analysis: Adverb, 'far off, in the distance'; locational, often paired with от for 'far from'.

покорили.analysis: Past pl. of покорить (perf., 'to conquer, subdue, captivate'); completed act, plural agreement.

леса.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative pl. of лес (m. noun, 'forest'); stressed-ending plural леса́.

подстриг.analysis: Past m. sg. of подстричь (perf., 'to trim, cut hair'); completed act, zero past suffix after -г stem.

кусты.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of куст (m. noun, 'bush, shrub'); stressed-ending plural.

чистым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of чистый (adj., 'clean, pure'); agrees with its noun.

огню.analysis: Dative sg. of огонь (m. noun, 'fire'); marks recipient or direction; fleeting vowel drops (огн-).

острову.analysis: Dative sg. of остров (m. noun, 'island'); marks recipient or direction toward.

гармонии.analysis: Genitive/dative/prepositional sg. of гармония (f. noun, 'harmony'); -ия noun with -ии oblique.

купаются.analysis: 3pl present of купаться (impf., reflexive, 'to bathe, swim'); ongoing or habitual action.

солнцу.analysis: Dative sg. of солнце (n. noun, 'sun'); marks recipient or direction toward.

тёплым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of тёплый (adj., 'warm'); agrees with its noun.

травы.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of трава (f. noun, 'grass, herb').

цветке.analysis: Prepositional sg. of цветок (m. noun, 'flower'); fleeting vowel drops (цветк-); used after в/о/на.

ветре.analysis: Prepositional sg. of ветер (m. noun, 'wind'); fleeting vowel drops (ветр-); used after в/о/на.

свежем.analysis: Prepositional m./n. sg. of свежий (adj., 'fresh'); soft-stem adjective agreeing with its noun.

государству.analysis: Dative sg. of государство (n. noun, 'state, country'); marks recipient or beneficiary.

первую.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of первый (ordinal numeral/adj., 'first'); agrees with feminine direct object.

рисуют.analysis: 3pl present of рисовать (impf., 'to draw, paint'); first-conjugation with -ова-/-у- alternation.

продал.analysis: Past m. sg. of продать (perf., 'to sell'); perfective of продавать, a completed sale.

улетела.analysis: Past f. sg. of улететь (perf., 'to fly away'); completed departure by air, feminine subject.

часе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of час (m. noun, 'hour'); used after в/о/на for time references.

годом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of год (m. noun, 'year'); marks means or time, e.g. 'with each year'.

прошедшие.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of прошедший (past active participle of пройти, 'having passed'); adjectival.

сезон.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of сезон (m. noun, 'season'); inanimate, regular hard-stem.

ездили.analysis: Past pl. of ездить (impf., multidirectional 'to go by vehicle'); repeated or return trips.

решилось.analysis: Past n. sg. of решиться (perf., reflexive, 'to be resolved, decided'); completed, neuter subject.

дел.analysis: Genitive pl. of дело (n. noun, 'matter, affair, deed'); zero-ending form after quantity.

собор.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of собор (m. noun, 'cathedral'); inanimate, regular hard-stem.

веками.analysis: Instrumental pl. of век (m. noun, 'century, age'); adverbial sense 'over centuries'.

моряки.analysis: Nominative pl. of моряк (m. noun, 'sailor'); animate, stressed-ending plural.

поехали.analysis: Past pl. of поехать (perf., 'to set off by vehicle'); completed start of a trip; colloquial 'let's go!'.

самолёту.analysis: Dative sg. of самолёт (m. noun, 'airplane'); marks recipient or direction toward.

храню.analysis: 1sg present of хранить (impf., 'to keep, store, preserve'); second-conjugation.

сложного.analysis: Genitive m./n. sg. of сложный (adj., 'complex, complicated, difficult'); agrees with its noun.

выросла.analysis: Past f. sg. of вырасти (perf., 'to grow up, increase'); completed growth, feminine subject.

километру.analysis: Dative sg. of километр (m. noun, 'kilometer'); marks recipient or measure of progression.

строгий.analysis: Nominative m. sg. of строгий (adj., 'strict, stern'); velar-stem hard adjective.

метре.analysis: Prepositional sg. of метр (m. noun, 'meter'); used after в/о/на for measure or location.

очередях.analysis: Prepositional pl. of очередь (f. noun, 'queue, line, turn'); soft-sign noun, used after в/о/на.

приказах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of приказ (m. noun, 'order, command'); used after в/о/на.

принесите.analysis: 2pl imperative of принести (perf., 'to bring'); formal or plural command for a single completed act.

оплачены.analysis: Short-form pl. past passive participle of оплатить (perf., 'to pay for'); predicative 'are paid'.

невероятно.analysis: Adverb, 'incredibly, unbelievably', from невероятный; also predicative 'it is incredible'.

приносит.analysis: 3sg present of приносить (impf., 'to bring'); second-conjugation, ongoing or habitual action.

плоды.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of плод (m. noun, 'fruit, result'); stressed-ending plural.

добавили.analysis: Past pl. of добавить (perf., 'to add'); perfective of добавлять, a completed addition.

вспоминали.analysis: Past pl. of вспоминать (impf., 'to recall/recollect'); imperfective stresses repeated or ongoing recollection.

дочери.analysis: Of дочь (f. noun, 'daughter'); genitive/dative/prepositional sg. or nominative pl. — context disambiguates.

помогаю.analysis: 1sg present of помогать (impf., 'to help'); takes dative object. Perfective counterpart помочь.

жён.analysis: Genitive pl. of жена (f. noun, 'wife'); zero-ending form with fill vowel ё.

умный.analysis: Adjective (m. sg. nom.), 'intelligent/clever', from ум ('mind'). Comparative умнее.

врачей.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of врач (m. noun, 'doctor/physician'); animate, so acc. = gen.

дружная.analysis: Adjective (f. sg. nom.) of дружный, 'harmonious/close-knit', from друг ('friend'); of a close group.

вырастила.analysis: Past f. sg. of вырастить (perf., 'to raise/grow'); perfective signals completed rearing or cultivation.

молока.analysis: Genitive sg. of молоко (n. noun, 'milk'); partitive/quantity form, e.g. стакан молока.

пирог.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of пирог (m. noun, 'pie/pastry'); inanimate, so acc. = nom.

свежей.analysis: Adjective (f. sg. gen./dat./instr./prep.) of свежий, 'fresh'; soft-stem oblique form.

полезна.analysis: Short-form f. sg. of полезный, 'useful/healthy'; predicative, e.g. она полезна.

телефонной.analysis: Adjective (f. sg. gen./dat./instr./prep.) of телефонный, 'telephone-', from телефон.

белого.analysis: Adjective (m./n. sg. gen./acc.) of белый, 'white'; animate masc. accusative or genitive.

предпочитает.analysis: 3sg present of предпочитать (impf., 'to prefer'); perfective counterpart предпочесть.

берегом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of берег (m. noun, 'shore/bank'); prepositional form is берегу (locative).

листья.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of лист (m. noun) in the 'leaf' sense; irregular -ья plural.

радовались.analysis: Past pl. of радоваться (impf., reflexive, 'to be glad/rejoice'); takes dative of what gladdens.

вершины.analysis: Of вершина (f. noun, 'summit/peak'); genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl.

камня.analysis: Genitive sg. of камень (m. noun, 'stone'); fleeting vowel е drops in oblique cases.

любуются.analysis: 3pl present of любоваться (impf., reflexive, 'to admire/gaze at'); takes instrumental object.

куста.analysis: Genitive sg. of куст (m. noun, 'bush/shrub'); inanimate.

небом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of небо (n. noun, 'sky/heaven'); e.g. под небом ('under the sky').

огнём.analysis: Instrumental sg. of огонь (m. noun, 'fire'); fleeting vowel о drops in oblique cases.

острове.analysis: Prepositional sg. of остров (m. noun, 'island'); e.g. на острове ('on the island').

природой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of природа (f. noun, 'nature'); e.g. любоваться природой.

радуются.analysis: 3pl present of радоваться (impf., reflexive, 'to be glad/rejoice'); takes dative object.

светом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of свет (m. noun, 'light'); also means 'world' in fixed phrases.

корова.analysis: Nominative sg. of корова (f. noun, 'cow'); animate.

букет.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of букет (m. noun, 'bouquet'); inanimate, so acc. = nom.

ветром.analysis: Instrumental sg. of ветер (m. noun, 'wind'); fleeting vowel е drops in oblique cases.

воздухе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of воздух (m. noun, 'air'); e.g. в воздухе ('in the air').

падает.analysis: 3sg present of падать (impf., 'to fall'); perfective counterpart упасть.

звезду.analysis: Accusative sg. of звезда (f. noun, 'star'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

ярких.analysis: Adjective (pl. gen./prep. or animate acc.) of яркий, 'bright/vivid'. Comparative ярче.

двух.analysis: Oblique form (gen./prep.) of numeral два/две ('two'); e.g. двух домов.

кормлю.analysis: 1sg present of кормить (impf., 'to feed'); stem mutation м→мл in 1sg. Perfective накормить.

шестьдесят.analysis: Cardinal numeral 'sixty'; compound declining both halves (шестидесяти in oblique cases).

путешествовал.analysis: Past m. sg. of путешествовать (impf., 'to travel'); imperfective stressing the process of travelling.

жаркими.analysis: Adjective (pl. instr.) of жаркий, 'hot' (of weather). Comparative жарче.

начнутся.analysis: 3pl future of начаться (perf., reflexive, 'to begin/start'); intransitive perfective of начинаться.

секунд.analysis: Genitive pl. of секунда (f. noun, 'second'); used after numerals 5+.

делятся.analysis: 3pl present of делиться (impf., reflexive, 'to share/be divided'); takes instrumental of what is shared.

пережил.analysis: Past m. sg. of пережить (perf., 'to live through/survive'); perfective of переживать.

спорта.analysis: Genitive sg. of спорт (m. noun, 'sport'); e.g. вид спорта ('kind of sport').

корабля.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of корабль (m. noun, 'ship'); soft-stem masc.

парковке.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of парковка (f. noun, 'parking/car park'); e.g. на парковке.

самолётом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of самолёт (m. noun, 'airplane'); means of transport, e.g. лететь самолётом.

открылись.analysis: Past pl. of открыться (perf., reflexive, 'to open'); intransitive, of things opening by themselves.

делах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of дело (n. noun, 'matter/affair/business'); e.g. в делах.

торгует.analysis: 3sg present of торговать (impf., 'to trade/sell'); takes instrumental of goods sold.

устаю.analysis: 1sg present of уставать (impf., 'to get tired'); perfective counterpart устать.

известная.analysis: Adjective (f. sg. nom.) of известный, 'famous/well-known'. Comparative известнее.

верёвки.analysis: Of верёвка (f. noun, 'rope/string'); genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl.

приказа.analysis: Genitive sg. of приказ (m. noun, 'order/command'); e.g. без приказа.

подорожал.analysis: Past m. sg. of подорожать (perf., 'to rise in price'); from дорогой ('expensive').

банковского.analysis: Adjective (m./n. sg. gen./acc.) of банковский, 'bank-/banking', from банк.

проверяю.analysis: 1sg present of проверять (impf., 'to check/verify'); perfective counterpart проверить.

велика.analysis: Short-form f. sg. of великий/великий 'great' or велик 'too large'; predicative, e.g. юбка велика.

трудом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of труд (m. noun, 'labor/work'); in с трудом means 'with difficulty'.

цену.analysis: Accusative sg. of цена (f. noun, 'price/cost'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

тысячей.analysis: Instrumental sg. of тысяча (numeral-noun, 'thousand'); also spelled тысячью.

подарил.analysis: Past m. sg. of подарить (perf., 'to give as a gift'); perfective of дарить, marking a completed act.

гордимся.analysis: 1pl present of гордиться (impf., 'to be proud'); reflexive verb governing the instrumental.

купила.analysis: Past f. sg. of купить (perf., 'to buy'); perfective of покупать, signaling a completed purchase.

отцу.analysis: Dative sg. of отец (m. noun, 'father'); recipient form with fleeting vowel dropped (отец → отц-).

игрушку.analysis: Accusative sg. of игрушка (f. noun, 'toy'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

традициями.analysis: Instrumental pl. of традиция (f. noun, 'tradition'); often used with гордиться or as an accompaniment.

поддержит.analysis: 3sg future of поддержать (perf., 'to support'); perfective of поддерживать, denoting a single completed act.

трёх.analysis: Genitive/prepositional form of три (numeral, 'three'); used after prepositions and in oblique cases.

холодильнике.analysis: Prepositional sg. of холодильник (m. noun, 'refrigerator'); locative form after в.

чае.analysis: Prepositional sg. of чай (m. noun, 'tea'); locative form after в/о.

радуется.analysis: 3sg present of радоваться (impf., 'to be glad'); reflexive verb governing the dative.

налил.analysis: Past m. sg. of налить (perf., 'to pour'); perfective of наливать, marking a completed pour.

трубки.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of трубка (f. noun, 'tube/pipe/receiver').

грузинские.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of грузинский (relational adj., 'Georgian'); agrees with plural nouns.

водке.analysis: Dative or prepositional sg. of водка (f. noun, 'vodka'); oblique form.

отплыла.analysis: Past f. sg. of отплыть (perf., 'to sail away'); perfective of отплывать, marking departure by water.

построен.analysis: Short m. sg. passive participle of построить (perf., 'to build'); predicate form, 'has been built'.

дыму.analysis: Prepositional/locative sg. of дым (m. noun, 'smoke'); special -у locative after в.

сделан.analysis: Short m. sg. passive participle of сделать (perf., 'to make'); predicate form, 'has been made'.

краем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of край (m. noun, 'edge/region'); means/accompaniment form.

подкралась.analysis: Past f. sg. of подкрасться (perf., 'to creep up'); reflexive perfective marking a completed stealthy approach.

грибов.analysis: Genitive pl. of гриб (m. noun, 'mushroom'); quantity/partitive form.

вечернее.analysis: Nominative/accusative n. sg. of вечерний (relational adj., 'evening'); agrees with neuter nouns.

огне.analysis: Prepositional sg. of огонь (m. noun, 'fire'); locative form with fleeting vowel dropped (огонь → огн-).

островом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of остров (m. noun, 'island'); means/accompaniment form.

невозможна.analysis: Short f. sg. of невозможный (adj., 'impossible'); predicate form agreeing with a f. subject.

первому.analysis: Dative m./n. sg. of первый (ordinal adj., 'first'); recipient/direction form.

освещается.analysis: 3sg present of освещаться (impf., 'to be lit'); reflexive/passive of освещать.

дневном.analysis: Prepositional m./n. sg. of дневной (relational adj., 'daytime'); locative agreement form.

покрыто.analysis: Short n. sg. passive participle of покрыть (perf., 'to cover'); predicate form, 'has been covered'.

белых.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of белый (adj., 'white'); oblique plural agreement form.

дуют.analysis: 3pl present of дуть (impf., 'to blow'); used of wind (ветры дуют).

душным.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of душный (adj., 'stuffy/muggy'); means/accompaniment form.

снежную.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of снежный (relational adj., 'snowy'); direct-object agreement form.

звезды.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of звезда (f. noun, 'star').

ночное.analysis: Nominative/accusative n. sg. of ночной (relational adj., 'nighttime'); agrees with neuter nouns.

лошадей.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of лошадь (f. noun, 'horse'); animate plural form.

собаке.analysis: Dative or prepositional sg. of собака (f. noun, 'dog'); oblique form.

круглые.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of круглый (adj., 'round'); agrees with plural nouns.

долгих.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of долгий (adj., 'long', of time); oblique plural agreement form.

целое.analysis: Nominative/accusative n. sg. of целый (adj., 'whole/entire'); agrees with neuter nouns.

минуты.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of минута (f. noun, 'minute').

каникулы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of каникулы (plurale tantum, 'school holidays/vacation'); no singular.

целые.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of целый (adj., 'whole/entire'); agrees with plural nouns.

светлым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of светлый (adj., 'bright/light'); means/accompaniment form.

прошлого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of прошлый (adj., 'past/last'); oblique agreement form.

угадать.analysis: Infinitive of угадать (perf., 'to guess right'); perfective of угадывать.

завелась.analysis: Past f. sg. of завестись (perf., 'to start up/appear'); reflexive, used of engines or animals.

летать.analysis: Infinitive of летать (impf., indeterminate 'to fly'); multidirectional counterpart of лететь.

банки.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of банка (f. noun, 'jar/can').

заработал.analysis: Past m. sg. of заработать (perf., 'to earn / to begin working'); perfective with ingressive sense.

яйцами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of яйцо (n. noun, 'egg'); means/accompaniment form.

километром.analysis: Instrumental sg. of километр (m. noun, 'kilometer'); means/measure form.

компаний.analysis: Genitive pl. of компания (f. noun, 'company/firm; group').

рулоне.analysis: Prepositional sg. of рулон (m. noun, 'roll', e.g. of paper); locative form after в.

начальника.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of начальник (m. animate noun, 'boss/chief').

доллара.analysis: Genitive sg. of доллар (m. noun, 'dollar'); also the form after два/три/четыре.

счёта.analysis: Genitive sg. of счёт (m. noun, 'account/bill/score'); oblique form.

удивляет.analysis: 3sg present of удивлять (impf., 'to surprise'); imperfective of удивить.

службу.analysis: Accusative sg. of служба (f. noun, 'service/duty/job'); direct-object form.

труду.analysis: Dative sg. of труд (m. noun, 'labor/work'); recipient/direction form.

соответствует.analysis: 3sg present of соответствовать (impf., 'to correspond/match'); governs the dative.

тысяч.analysis: Genitive pl. of тысяча (f. noun/numeral, 'thousand'); quantity form after numerals.

братом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of брат (m. noun, 'brother'); irregular plural братья.

дочерью.analysis: Instrumental sg. of дочь (f. noun, 'daughter'); stem extends to дочер- in oblique cases.

матерью.analysis: Instrumental sg. of мать (f. noun, 'mother'); stem extends to матер- in oblique cases.

отцом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of отец (m. noun, 'father'); fleeting vowel drops in oblique cases.

ребёнку.analysis: Dative sg. of ребёнок (m. noun, 'child'); suppletive plural дети.

роды.analysis: Plural-form noun роды (m., 'childbirth, labour'); homographic with sg. forms of род ('kind').

сестрой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of сестра (f. noun, 'sister'); irregular plural сёстры.

сыновей.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of сын (m. noun, 'son'); irregular plural stem сыновь-.

выпил.analysis: Past m. sg. of выпить (perf., 'to drink up'); perfective of пить, marks completion.

чаи.analysis: Nominative pl. of чай (m. noun, 'tea'); plural denotes varieties or servings.

чистого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of чистый (adj., 'clean, pure'); comparative чище.

трубке.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of трубка (f. noun, 'tube, pipe, phone receiver'); diminutive of труба.

известны.analysis: Short-form pl. of известный (adj., 'known, famous'); predicative.

закусывал.analysis: Past m. sg. of закусывать (impf., 'to have a snack, eat with drink'); imperfective of закусить.

крутые.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of крутой (adj., 'steep; abrupt; slang cool'); comparative круче.

синоптики.analysis: Nominative pl. of синоптик (m. noun, 'weather forecaster').

печи.analysis: Genitive/dative/prepositional sg. or nominative pl. of печь (f. noun, 'stove, furnace').

горе.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of горе (n. noun, 'grief'); homographic with prep. sg. of гора ('mountain').

камню.analysis: Dative sg. of камень (m. noun, 'stone'); fleeting vowel drops in oblique cases.

крае.analysis: Prepositional sg. of край (m. noun, 'edge, border, territory'); locative край takes -ю in 'на краю'.

кусту.analysis: Dative sg. of куст (m. noun, 'bush, shrub').

лесе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of лес (m. noun, 'forest'); locative takes -у in 'в лесу'.

небеса.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of небо (n. noun, 'sky'); irregular plural stem небес-.

сгорели.analysis: Past pl. of сгореть (perf., 'to burn up, be consumed by fire'); perfective of сгорать.

доплыли.analysis: Past pl. of доплыть (perf., 'to swim/sail as far as'); perfective with до- marking arrival.

дарит.analysis: 3sg present of дарить (impf., 'to give as a gift'); perfective подарить.

покрыта.analysis: Short-form f. sg. past passive participle of покрыть (perf., 'to cover'); predicative.

солнцем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of солнце (n. noun, 'sun'); silent л in pronunciation.

луны.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative pl. of луна (f. noun, 'moon').

травой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of трава (f. noun, 'grass, herb').

цветов.analysis: Genitive pl. of цветок ('flower') or цвет ('colour'); both share the form цветов.

горный.analysis: Adjective m. sg. nom., 'mountain, mountainous' (from гора).

кормит.analysis: 3sg present of кормить (impf., 'to feed'); perfective накормить.

готовлюсь.analysis: 1sg present of готовиться (impf., reflexive 'to prepare oneself'); perfective подготовиться.

жаркое.analysis: N. sg. of жаркий (adj., 'hot'); substantivized as жаркое ('roast dish'); comparative жарче.

месяца.analysis: Genitive sg. of месяц (m. noun, 'month; moon').

каждой.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of каждый (determiner, 'each, every').

суток.analysis: Genitive pl. of сутки (plurale tantum, 'twenty-four-hour period').

раннее.analysis: N. sg. of ранний (adj., 'early'); soft-stem adjective; comparative раньше.

века.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative pl. of век (m. noun, 'century, age'); nom. pl. also века́.

разного.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of разный (adj., 'different, various').

кораблю.analysis: Dative sg. of корабль (m. noun, 'ship, vessel').

вечерний.analysis: Adjective m. sg. nom., 'evening' (from вечер); soft-stem adjective.

сравнивал.analysis: Past m. sg. of сравнивать (impf., 'to compare'); perfective сравнить.

деньгам.analysis: Dative pl. of деньги (plurale tantum, 'money'); no singular in this sense.

десятками.analysis: Instrumental pl. of десяток (m. noun, 'group of ten'); idiomatic 'in tens, by the dozen'.

заключили.analysis: Past pl. of заключить (perf., 'to conclude, enclose, imprison'); perfective of заключать.

подчинились.analysis: Past pl. of подчиниться (perf., reflexive 'to submit, obey'); perfective of подчиняться.

рублю.analysis: Dative sg. of рубль (m. noun, 'rouble'); homographic with 1sg of рубить ('to chop').

счёте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of счёт (m. noun, 'account, score, bill'); fleeting vowel in oblique cases.

силе.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of сила (f. noun, 'strength, force, power').

службы.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative pl. of служба (f. noun, 'service, employment, duty').

добился.analysis: Past m. sg. of добиться (perf., reflexive 'to achieve, obtain'); perfective of добиваться.

ценой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of цена (f. noun, 'price'); idiomatic 'at the price of'.

брате.analysis: Prepositional sg. of брат (m. noun, 'brother'); used after о/в, e.g. о брате 'about a brother'.

дочерей.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of дочь (f. noun, 'daughter'); stem extends with -ер- in plural.

матерей.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of мать (f. noun, 'mother'); stem extends with -ер- in plural.

отцы.analysis: Nominative pl. of отец (m. noun, 'father'); fleeting vowel -е- drops before the plural ending.

ребёнке.analysis: Prepositional sg. of ребёнок (m. noun, 'child'); used after о/в, e.g. о ребёнке.

сёстры.analysis: Nominative pl. of сестра (f. noun, 'sister'); also genitive sg. with stress shift.

жену.analysis: Accusative sg. of жена (f. noun, 'wife'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

половину.analysis: Accusative sg. of половина (f. noun, 'half'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

рыбой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of рыба (f. noun, 'fish'); used for means/with, e.g. кормить рыбой.

одним.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. of один (numeral/pronoun, 'one'); agrees with instrumental noun.

трубкой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of трубка (f. noun, 'tube/pipe/phone receiver'); diminutive of труба.

мире.analysis: Prepositional sg. of мир (m. noun, 'world' or 'peace'); used after о/в, e.g. в мире.

солёным.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of солёный (adj., 'salty/salted').

тянулись.analysis: Past pl. of тянуться (impf., 'to stretch/extend/drag on'); reflexive in -ся.

чёрным.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of чёрный (adj., 'black').

горой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of гора (f. noun, 'mountain'); used for means/with, e.g. за горой.

молотком.analysis: Instrumental sg. of молоток (m. noun, 'hammer'); used for means, e.g. бить молотком.

кустом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of куст (m. noun, 'bush/shrub'); used for means/with, e.g. за кустом.

лесам.analysis: Dative pl. of лес (m. noun, 'forest/woods'); indirect-object/along form.

любуемся.analysis: 1pl present of любоваться (impf., 'to admire'); reflexive in -ся, takes instrumental.

распространился.analysis: Past m. sg. of распространиться (perf., 'to spread/disseminate'); reflexive in -ся.

океане.analysis: Prepositional sg. of океан (m. noun, 'ocean'); used after о/в, e.g. в океане.

белым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of белый (adj., 'white').

звёздах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of звезда (f. noun, 'star'); used after о/в, e.g. о звёздах.

зажглись.analysis: Past pl. of зажечься (perf., 'to light up/ignite'); reflexive in -ся.

лошади.analysis: Genitive/dative/prep. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of лошадь (f. noun, 'horse').

поймала.analysis: Past f. sg. of поймать (perf., 'to catch'); perfective of ловить, signaling a completed catch.

дню.analysis: Dative sg. of день (m. noun, 'day'); indirect-object form, fleeting -е- drops.

лета.analysis: Genitive sg. of лето (n. noun, 'summer'); also nom./acc. pl. ('years').

следующим.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of следующий (adj., 'next/following').

дошло.analysis: Past n. sg. of дойти (perf., 'to reach/arrive on foot'); perfective.

возраста.analysis: Genitive sg. of возраст (m. noun, 'age'); also nom./acc. pl.

плыли.analysis: Past pl. of плыть (impf., 'to swim/sail/float'); unidirectional motion verb.

поезду.analysis: Dative sg. of поезд (m. noun, 'train'); indirect-object/by form, e.g. по поезду.

условия.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. (or gen. sg.) of условие (n. noun, 'condition/term').

расплатился.analysis: Past m. sg. of расплатиться (perf., 'to pay off/settle accounts'); reflexive in -ся.

десятке.analysis: Prepositional sg. of десяток (m. noun, 'a ten/group of ten'); fleeting -о- drops.

первом.analysis: Prepositional m./n. sg. of первый (ordinal adj., 'first').

равен.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of равный (adj., 'equal'); predicate use, e.g. он равен.

недоволен.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of недовольный (adj., 'displeased'); predicate, takes instrumental.

последним.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of последний (adj., 'last/final').

заплатил.analysis: Past m. sg. of заплатить (perf., 'to pay'); perfective of платить.

воли.analysis: Genitive/dative/prep. sg. of воля (f. noun, 'will/freedom'); e.g. без воли.
