технологии.analysis: Genitive/dative/prepositional sg. or nom./acc. pl. of технология (f. noun, 'technology'); ending -ии.

зависит.analysis: 3sg present of зависеть (impf., 'to depend'); governs от + genitive.

кораблём.analysis: Instrumental sg. of корабль (m. noun, 'ship'); soft-stem, stressed ending -ём.

надёжный.analysis: M. sg. nominative of надёжный (adj., 'reliable'); ending -ый.

банков.analysis: Genitive pl. of банк (m. noun, 'bank'); ending -ов.

наличными.analysis: Instrumental pl. of наличные (substantivized adj., 'cash'); ending -ыми, as платить наличными.

штук.analysis: Genitive pl. of штука (f. noun, 'piece/item'); counting word after numerals, ending -∅.

километре.analysis: Prepositional sg. of километр (m. noun, 'kilometer'); ending -е.

сантиметрам.analysis: Dative pl. of сантиметр (m. noun, 'centimeter'); ending -ам.

длиной.analysis: Instrumental sg. of длина (f. noun, 'length'); measurement form (длиной в метр).

приказом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of приказ (m. noun, 'order/command'); ending -ом.

рублём.analysis: Instrumental sg. of рубль (m. noun, 'ruble'); soft-stem, stressed ending -ём.

счёту.analysis: Dative sg. of счёт (m. noun, 'account/bill/score'); ending -у.

управляет.analysis: 3sg present of управлять (impf., 'to manage/control'); governs instrumental case.

службе.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of служба (f. noun, 'service/duty'); ending -е.

труде.analysis: Prepositional sg. of труд (m. noun, 'labor/work'); ending -е.

указанной.analysis: F. sg. gen./dat./instr./prep. of указанный (past passive part. of указать, 'specified'); ending -ой.

деду.analysis: Dative sg. of дед (m. noun, 'grandfather'); indirect-object form, 'to grandfather'.

дяди.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom. pl.) of дядя (m. noun, 'uncle'); -я becomes -и.

подруги.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom. pl.) of подруга (f. noun, 'female friend'); -а becomes -и.

папу.analysis: Accusative sg. of папа (m. noun, 'dad'); direct-object form, -а becomes -у.

детьми.analysis: Instrumental pl. of дети (pl. noun, 'children'); irregular ending -ьми.

старших.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of старший (adj. used as noun, 'elder/senior'); comparative of старый.

жене.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of жена (f. noun, 'wife'); -а becomes -е.

штопором.analysis: Instrumental sg. of штопор (m. noun, 'corkscrew'); 'with a corkscrew'.

неполный.analysis: Adjective, 'incomplete/not full' (m. sg.); negated form of полный.

рынке.analysis: Prepositional sg. of рынок (m. noun, 'market'); 'at the market', fleeting -о- drops.

стаканов.analysis: Genitive pl. of стакан (m. noun, 'drinking glass'); counted/quantity form.

местные.analysis: Nominative pl. of местный (adj., 'local'); from место.

праздничном.analysis: Prepositional m.-n. sg. of праздничный (adj., 'festive, holiday-'); from праздник.

посадили.analysis: Past pl. of посадить (perf., 'to plant, to seat'); perfective of сажать/садить.

дождю.analysis: Dative sg. of дождь (m. noun, 'rain'); 'to/by the rain'.

дыме.analysis: Prepositional sg. of дым (m. noun, 'smoke'); 'in the smoke'.

горах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of гора (f. noun, 'mountain'); 'in the mountains'.

прилетели.analysis: Past pl. of прилететь (perf., 'to fly in, arrive flying'); perfective of прилетать.

кусте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of куст (m. noun, 'bush'); 'in/on the bush'.

чайки.analysis: Nominative pl. (or gen. sg.) of чайка (f. noun, 'seagull'); -а becomes -и.

развели.analysis: Past pl. of развести (perf., 'to light a fire, breed, dilute'); perfective of разводить.

светятся.analysis: 3pl present of светиться (impf., 'to glow, shine'); reflexive of светить.

северную.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of северный (adj., 'northern'); from север.

переплыли.analysis: Past pl. of переплыть (perf., 'to swim/sail across'); perfective of переплывать.

растаял.analysis: Past m. sg. of растаять (perf., 'to melt, thaw'); perfective of таять.

облаками.analysis: Instrumental pl. of облако (n. noun, 'cloud'); 'with/by the clouds'.

звёзд.analysis: Genitive pl. of звезда (f. noun, 'star'); counted/quantity form.

цветка.analysis: Genitive sg. of цветок (m. noun, 'flower'); fleeting -о- drops.

впусти.analysis: 2sg imperative of впустить (perf., 'to let in, admit'); perfective of впускать.

богатая.analysis: Nominative f. sg. of богатый (adj., 'rich, wealthy').

написано.analysis: Short n. sg. past passive participle of написать (perf., 'to write').

любовался.analysis: Past m. sg. of любоваться (impf., 'to admire, gaze with pleasure'); reflexive verb.

лошадью.analysis: Instrumental sg. of лошадь (f. noun, 'horse'); soft-sign declension, 'with a horse'.

птице.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of птица (f. noun, 'bird'); -а becomes -е.

прошло.analysis: Past n. sg. of пройти (perf., 'to pass, go by'); of time/events.

вышло.analysis: Past n. sg. of выйти (perf., 'to go out, come out, turn out'); perfective of выходить.

накопим.analysis: 1pl future of накопить (perf., 'to accumulate, save up'); perfective of копить.

месяцем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of месяц (m. noun, 'month'; also 'moon'); 'with/by a month'.

поговорили.analysis: Past pl. of поговорить (perf., 'to talk a while'); delimitative perfective of говорить.

теряй.analysis: 2sg imperative of терять (impf., 'to lose'); often negated as не теряй.

решится.analysis: 3sg future of решиться (perf., 'to be decided; to dare'); reflexive of решить.

наслаждались.analysis: Past pl. of наслаждаться (impf., 'to enjoy, take delight in'); takes instrumental.

меняются.analysis: 3pl present of меняться (impf., 'to change, vary'); reflexive of менять.

возрастом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of возраст (m. noun, 'age'); 'with/by age'.

корабле.analysis: Prepositional sg. of корабль (m. noun, 'ship'); 'on the ship'.

поездов.analysis: Genitive pl. of поезд (m. noun, 'train'); counted/quantity form.

банка.analysis: Nominative sg. of банка (f. noun, 'jar, can'); or gen. sg. of банк (m., 'bank').

ума.analysis: Genitive sg. of ум (m. noun, 'mind, intellect, wit').

деньгах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of деньги (pl. noun, 'money'); 'about/in money'.

десятку.analysis: Accusative/dative sg. of десятка (f. noun, 'a ten, ten-unit note').

километров.analysis: Genitive pl. of километр (m. noun, 'kilometer'); counted/quantity form.

ткани.analysis: Genitive/dative/prepositional sg. (or nom. pl.) of ткань (f. noun, 'fabric, tissue').

кассу.analysis: Accusative sg. of касса (f. noun, 'cash register, box office'); -а becomes -у.

приказе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of приказ (m. noun, 'order, command'); 'in the order'.

слабом.analysis: Prepositional m.-n. sg. of слабый (adj., 'weak, faint').

наличным.analysis: Instrumental m.-n. sg. (or dat. pl.) of наличный (adj., 'cash, available on hand').

силой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of сила (f. noun, 'strength, force'); 'with/by force'.

службой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of служба (f. noun, 'service, duty'); 'with/by service'.

создан.analysis: Short m. sg. past passive participle of создать (perf., 'to create, make').

сравнивают.analysis: 3pl present of сравнивать (impf., 'to compare'); imperfective of сравнить.

дедом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of дед (m. noun, 'grandfather'); used with prepositions like с or as agent/means.

дяде.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of дядя (m. noun, 'uncle'); soft-stem masculine declining like a feminine noun.

мужу.analysis: Dative sg. of муж (m. noun, 'husband'); indirect-object form, e.g. recipient of an action.

папы.analysis: Genitive sg. of папа (m. noun, 'dad'); possession/absence form, also nominative pl. 'dads'.

рода.analysis: Genitive sg. of род (m. noun, 'kind/genus/clan'); also grammatical gender. Possession/quantity form.

родителя.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of родитель (m. noun, 'parent'); animate, so acc. matches gen.

сыну.analysis: Dative sg. of сын (m. noun, 'son'); indirect-object form indicating recipient.

женой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of жена (f. noun, 'wife'); used with с or as means/agent.

бутылкой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of бутылка (f. noun, 'bottle'); used with с or as instrument.

добавил.analysis: Past m. sg. of добавить (perf., 'to add'); perfective signaling a completed addition.

озере.analysis: Prepositional sg. of озеро (n. noun, 'lake'); location form, e.g. на озере.

помыл.analysis: Past m. sg. of помыть (perf., 'to wash'); perfective of мыть, signaling a completed wash.

бокал.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of бокал (m. noun, 'wineglass/goblet'); inanimate, so acc. matches nom.

воде.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of вода (f. noun, 'water'); location form, e.g. в воде.

лодка.analysis: Nominative sg. of лодка (f. noun, 'boat/small craft'); subject form.

подлетела.analysis: Past f. sg. of подлететь (perf., 'to fly up to/approach by air'); perfective with directional prefix под-.

дожде.analysis: Prepositional sg. of дождь (m. noun, 'rain'); location/topic form, e.g. о дожде, в дожде.

скрылся.analysis: Past m. sg. of скрыться (perf., 'to vanish/hide oneself'); reflexive perfective with -ся.

виднеются.analysis: 3pl present of виднеться (impf., 'to be visible/show'); reflexive verb describing what can be seen.

камни.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of камень (m. noun, 'stone'); inanimate plural.

краёв.analysis: Genitive pl. of край (m. noun, 'edge/region'); quantity/absence form, keeps ё.

созрели.analysis: Past pl. of созреть (perf., 'to ripen/mature'); perfective signaling completed ripening.

неба.analysis: Genitive sg. of небо (n. noun, 'sky/heaven'); possession/absence form.

огня.analysis: Genitive sg. of огонь (m. noun, 'fire'); possession/absence form, e.g. без огня.

подходи.analysis: Imperative sg. of подходить (impf., 'to approach'); command to draw near.

природу.analysis: Accusative sg. of природа (f. noun, 'nature'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

широкую.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of широкий (adj., 'wide/broad'); agrees with a feminine direct object.

дорогах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of дорога (f. noun, 'road'); location form, e.g. на дорогах.

подвале.analysis: Prepositional sg. of подвал (m. noun, 'basement/cellar'); location form, e.g. в подвале.

зелёной.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of зелёный (adj., 'green'); agrees with a feminine noun, keeps ё.

цветку.analysis: Dative sg. of цветок (m. noun, 'flower'); indirect-object form, fleeting vowel о drops.

ветра.analysis: Genitive sg. of ветер (m. noun, 'wind'); possession/absence form, fleeting vowel е drops.

загрязнённого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m. sg. of загрязнённый (adj./past pass. part., 'polluted'); from загрязнить, keeps ё.

семена.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of семя (n. noun, 'seed'); irregular plural with -ен- infix.

стихов.analysis: Genitive pl. of стих (m. noun, 'verse/poem'); quantity/absence form.

яркой.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of яркий (adj., 'bright/vivid'); agrees with a feminine noun.

пасутся.analysis: 3pl present of пастись (impf., 'to graze'); reflexive verb describing grazing animals.

следил.analysis: Past m. sg. of следить (impf., 'to watch/track/follow'); ongoing observation, governs за + instr.

часу.analysis: Locative/dative sg. of час (m. noun, 'hour'); used after в for time, e.g. в первом часу.

нетерпением.analysis: Instrumental sg. of нетерпение (n. noun, 'impatience'); used in с нетерпением, 'eagerly'.

лете.analysis: Prepositional sg. of лето (n. noun, 'summer'); time form, e.g. летом vs. о лете.

праздников.analysis: Genitive pl. of праздник (m. noun, 'holiday/celebration'); quantity/absence form.

тишине.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of тишина (f. noun, 'silence/quiet'); location form, e.g. в тишине.

секунды.analysis: Genitive sg. or nom./acc. pl. of секунда (f. noun, 'second'); time unit, also used after numerals.

целыми.analysis: Instrumental pl. of целый (adj., 'whole/entire'); e.g. целыми днями, 'for days on end'.

вечере.analysis: Prepositional sg. of вечер (m. noun, 'evening'); time form, e.g. о вечере, на вечере.

веком.analysis: Instrumental sg. of век (m. noun, 'century/age'); used with с or as means.

возрастов.analysis: Genitive pl. of возраст (m. noun, 'age'); quantity/absence form, e.g. разных возрастов.

доберёмся.analysis: 1pl future of добраться (perf., 'to reach/make it'); reflexive perfective, keeps ё.

прилёта.analysis: Genitive sg. of прилёт (m. noun, 'arrival by air'); possession/absence form, keeps ё.

банку.analysis: Accusative sg. of банка (f. noun, 'jar/can'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

делу.analysis: Dative sg. of дело (n. noun, 'matter/affair/business'); indirect-object form, e.g. по делу.

потратил.analysis: Past m. sg. of потратить (perf., 'to spend/expend'); perfective of тратить, signaling a completed outlay.

продают.analysis: 3pl present of продавать (impf., 'to sell'); ongoing/habitual selling.

километры.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of километр (m. noun, 'kilometer'); distance unit.

метра.analysis: Genitive sg. of метр (m. noun, 'meter'); length unit, also after numerals 2-4.

подойдите.analysis: Imperative pl./polite of подойти (perf., 'to approach'); command to draw near.

действуем.analysis: 1pl present of действовать (impf., 'to act/operate'); ongoing action.

рубле.analysis: Prepositional sg. of рубль (m. noun, 'ruble'); currency unit, e.g. о рубле.

счётом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of счёт (m. noun, 'score/bill/account'); used with со or as means, keeps ё.

духа.analysis: Genitive sg. of дух (m. noun, 'spirit/breath/ghost'); possession/absence form.

круглосуточно.analysis: Adverb of time, from круглосуточный; '24 hours a day, nonstop'.

общим.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of общий (adj., 'common/general/shared'); agrees with its noun.

магазинов.analysis: Genitive pl. of магазин (m. noun, 'store/shop'); quantity/absence form.

кукла.analysis: Nominative sg. of кукла (f. noun, 'doll'); also denotes a puppet or marionette.

обе.analysis: Numeral/quantifier 'both' (f. form) of оба/обе; agrees with two feminine nouns; m./n. is оба.

взрослые.analysis: Nominative pl. of взрослый (adj./noun, 'adult'); substantivized adjective denoting grown people.

вблизи.analysis: Adverb/preposition 'nearby, close', from близкий; with genitive means 'near (something)'.

летает.analysis: 3sg present of летать (impf., 'to fly'); indeterminate motion verb (repeated/multidirectional flight).

поднимаются.analysis: 3pl present of подниматься (impf., reflexive, 'to rise/climb'); perfective is подняться.

таких.analysis: Genitive/prepositional/accusative pl. of такой (demonstrative adj., 'such, this kind of').

долгую.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of долгий (adj., 'long' in duration); contrasts with длинный (long in extent).

катаемся.natural: We ride; go for a ride.
катаемся.analysis: 1pl present of кататься (impf., reflexive, 'to ride/go for a ride'); used for skiing, skating, cycling.

лыжах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of лыжа (f. noun, 'ski'); на лыжах = 'on skis, skiing'.

прошедших.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of прошедший (past active participle of пройти, 'past, bygone').

тяжёлыми.analysis: Instrumental pl. of тяжёлый (adj., 'heavy, hard'); also figuratively 'difficult, severe'.

температура.analysis: Nominative sg. of температура (f. noun, 'temperature'); also colloquially 'fever'.

упала.analysis: Past f. sg. of упасть (perf., 'to fall'); perfective of падать, signaling a completed fall/drop.

одни.analysis: Nominative pl. of один ('one'); plural sense 'alone, on their own' or 'some, certain ones'.

охранник.analysis: Nominative sg. of охранник (m. noun, 'guard'), from охранять ('to guard'); female form охранница.

администратор.analysis: Nominative sg. of администратор (m. noun, 'administrator, manager'); also a receptionist or desk clerk.

стояло.analysis: Past n. sg. of стоять (impf., 'to stand'); denotes a thing positioned/located somewhere.

магазинах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of магазин (m. noun, 'store, shop'); в магазинах = 'in the stores'.

очередей.analysis: Genitive pl. of очередь (f. noun, 'queue, line, turn'); also means one's 'turn'.

двигается.analysis: 3sg present of двигаться (impf., reflexive, 'to move'); perfective двинуться.

уважают.analysis: 3pl present of уважать (impf., 'to respect, esteem'); takes accusative object.

ценим.analysis: 1pl present of ценить (impf., 'to value, prize, appreciate'); takes accusative object.

успеха.analysis: Genitive sg. of успех (m. noun, 'success'); желаю успеха = 'I wish you success'.

тяжёлым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. (or dative pl.) of тяжёлый (adj., 'heavy, hard, difficult').

раскрывается.analysis: 3sg present of раскрываться (impf., reflexive, 'to open up, unfold, be revealed'); perfective раскрыться.

изучают.analysis: 3pl present of изучать (impf., 'to study, learn in depth'); takes accusative object.

виды.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of вид (m. noun, 'kind, type, species; view, sight').

привыкли.analysis: Past pl. of привыкнуть (perf., 'to get used to'); perfective of привыкать, takes к + dative.

ежедневному.analysis: Dative m./n. sg. of ежедневный (adj., 'daily, everyday'), from день ('day').

талантлив.analysis: Short-form m. sg. adjective of талантливый ('talented'); predicative use, e.g. 'он талантлив'.

статью.analysis: Accusative sg. of статья (f. noun, 'article'); direct-object form, ending -ья becomes -ью.

деревенской.analysis: Adjective from деревенский ('rural, village-'), f. sg. genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional form.

веры.analysis: Genitive sg. of вера (f. noun, 'faith, belief'); ending -а becomes -ы.

храм.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of храм (m. noun, 'temple, church, place of worship').

члены.analysis: Nominative pl. of член (m. noun, 'member'); also 'limb' or grammatical 'term'.

леди.analysis: Indeclinable f. noun леди ('lady'); borrowed from English, same in all cases and numbers.

директором.analysis: Instrumental sg. of директор (m. noun, 'director, manager'); ending -ом marks instrument/role.

медсестра.analysis: Nominative sg. of медсестра (f. noun, 'nurse'); compound of мед- (medical) and сестра (sister).

нашими.analysis: Instrumental pl. of possessive наш ('our'); agrees with a plural noun in the instrumental.

генерала.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of генерал (m. animate noun, 'general'); ending -а for animate object.

возвращения.analysis: Genitive sg. of возвращение (n. noun, 'return, coming back'); verbal noun from возвращаться.

господина.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of господин (m. animate noun, 'gentleman, sir, master').

господ.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of господин (m. animate noun, 'gentleman'); irregular plural stem господ-.

госте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of гость (m. noun, 'guest'); used after о/в, e.g. 'о госте'.

гражданине.analysis: Prepositional sg. of гражданин (m. animate noun, 'citizen'); plural stem switches to граждан-.

капитана.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of капитан (m. animate noun, 'captain'); ending -а for animate object.

наградил.analysis: Past m. sg. of наградить (perf., 'to award, reward'); perfective of награждать, completed act.

приветливые.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of приветливый ('friendly, affable, welcoming').

пригласил.analysis: Past m. sg. of пригласить (perf., 'to invite'); perfective of приглашать, completed act.

прибыли.analysis: Past pl. of прибыть (perf., 'to arrive'); perfective of прибывать. Also genitive sg. of прибыль (profit).

великих.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of великий ('great, grand'); agrees with a plural noun.

лейтенантом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of лейтенант (m. animate noun, 'lieutenant'); ending -ом marks instrument/role.

любимые.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of любимый ('favorite, beloved'); passive participle of любить used as adjective.

мальчики.analysis: Nominative pl. of мальчик (m. animate noun, 'boy'); ending -и after stem in -к.

борода.analysis: Nominative sg. of борода (f. noun, 'beard'); stress shifts to ending in oblique cases.

начальнике.analysis: Prepositional sg. of начальник (m. animate noun, 'boss, chief, superior').

народы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of народ (m. noun, 'people, nation'); ethnic/national groups.

типичный.analysis: Adjective типичный ('typical, representative'), m. sg. nominative form.

офицеры.analysis: Nominative pl. of офицер (m. animate noun, 'officer'); military or police rank-holder.

парне.analysis: Prepositional sg. of парень (m. animate noun, 'guy, lad, boyfriend'); fleeting -е- drops in oblique cases.

читатели.analysis: Nominative pl. of читатель (m. animate noun, 'reader'); agent noun from читать.

полковнику.analysis: Dative sg. of полковник (m. animate noun, 'colonel'); indirect-object form, ending -у.

газеты.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of газета (f. noun, 'newspaper'); ending -ы.

профессорам.analysis: Dative pl. of профессор (m. animate noun, 'professor'); irregular nom. pl. профессора.

старика.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of старик (m. animate noun, 'old man'); ending -а for animate object.

товарищу.analysis: Dative sg. of товарищ (m. animate noun, 'comrade, mate'); indirect-object form, ending -у.

враче.analysis: Prepositional sg. of врач (m. animate noun, 'doctor, physician'); used after о/в.

умная.analysis: Feminine sg. nominative of умный ('clever, intelligent'); agrees with a f. noun.

бумагой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of бумага (f. noun, 'paper'); ending -ой marks instrument/means.

документе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of документ (m. noun, 'document'); used after о/в, e.g. 'в документе'.

попала.analysis: Past f. sg. of попасть (perf., 'to get into, hit the target, end up'); perfective of попадать.

проверил.analysis: Past m. sg. of проверить (perf., 'to check, verify'); perfective of проверять, completed act.

сайт.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of сайт (m. noun, 'website'); borrowed from English 'site'.

названия.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of название (n. noun, 'name, title' of a thing).

номере.analysis: Prepositional sg. of номер (m. noun, 'number; hotel room'); used after о/в.

рассказе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of рассказ (m. noun, 'story, tale, account'); used after о/в.

серьёзных.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of серьёзный ('serious, grave'); agrees with a plural noun.

оратора.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of оратор (m. animate noun, 'orator, public speaker').

телефоны.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of телефон (m. noun, 'telephone, phone').

парковку.analysis: Accusative sg. of парковка (f. noun, 'parking, parking lot'); ending -ка becomes -ку.

историей.analysis: Instrumental sg. of история (f. noun, 'history, story'); ending -ей marks instrument/means.

галерее.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of галерея (f. noun, 'gallery'); e.g. 'в галерее'.

увлекается.analysis: 3sg present of увлекаться (impf., reflexive, 'to be keen on, be into'); takes instrumental object.

по разному.analysis: Adverb по-разному ('differently, variously'); from разный, hyphenated по- pattern.

науки.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of наука (f. noun, 'science, scholarship'); ending -и.

образе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of образ (m. noun, 'image, form, manner'); e.g. 'таким образом' (instr.).

такого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of demonstrative такой ('such, that kind of'); ending -ого.

опытов.analysis: Genitive pl. of опыт (m. noun, 'experiment; experience'); ending -ов.

разбирают.analysis: 3pl present of разбирать (impf., 'to take apart, sort out, analyze'); perfective разобрать.

роману.analysis: Dative sg. of роман (m. noun, 'novel; romance'); indirect-object form, ending -у.

систему.analysis: Accusative sg. of система (f. noun, 'system'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

единой.analysis: Feminine sg. genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional of единый ('single, unified, sole').

границей.analysis: Instrumental sg. of граница (f. noun, 'border, boundary'); 'за границей' = abroad.

ванной.analysis: F. sg. genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional of ванная ('bathroom'); adjectival noun.

автора.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of автор (m. noun, 'author'); animate, so gen.=acc.

знакомую.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of знакомый (adj./n., 'familiar; acquaintance'); substantivized adjective.

сельских.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of сельский (adj., 'rural; village-'), agreeing with a plural noun.

богом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of бог (m. noun, 'god'); means 'by/with God', e.g. with быть or клясться.

древнего.analysis: Genitive/accusative m.-n. sg. of древний (soft adj., 'ancient; very old').

поблагодарил.analysis: Past m. sg. of поблагодарить (perf., 'to thank'); perfective of благодарить, completed act.

пожилой.analysis: Adjective, 'elderly; aged' (m. sg., nom.); of a person past middle age.

директоре.analysis: Prepositional sg. of директор (m. noun, 'director; manager'); used after о, в, на.

доктору.analysis: Dative sg. of доктор (m. noun, 'doctor'); indirect-object/recipient form.

докторами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of доктор (m. noun, 'doctor'); 'by/with doctors'.

издалека.analysis: Adverb of place, 'from a distance; from afar'; built on далеко ('far').

герою.analysis: Dative sg. of герой (m. noun, 'hero'); indirect-object/recipient form.

известного.analysis: Genitive/accusative m.-n. sg. of известный (adj., 'well-known; famous').

слуга.analysis: Nominative sg. of слуга (m. noun despite -а ending, 'servant'); takes masc. agreement.

права.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. or gen. sg. of право (n. noun, 'right; law'); pl. also means 'driver's licence'.

граждане.analysis: Nominative pl. of гражданин (m. noun, 'citizen'); irregular plural stem гражд-ане.

подчиняется.analysis: 3sg present of подчиняться (impf., 'to obey; submit to'); reflexive -ся verb, takes dative.

хозяев.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of хозяин (m. noun, 'owner; host; master'); irregular plural.

местных.analysis: Genitive/prepositional/acc. pl. of местный (adj., 'local; native to the place').

командиры.analysis: Nominative pl. of командир (m. noun, 'commander; commanding officer').

королей.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of король (m. noun, 'king'); animate, so gen.=acc.

лейтенанте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of лейтенант (m. noun, 'lieutenant'); used after о, в, на.

поддерживают.analysis: 3pl present of поддерживать (impf., 'to support; back; maintain'); imperfective of поддержать.

мальчиков.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of мальчик (m. noun, 'boy'); animate, so gen.=acc.

мужику.analysis: Dative sg. of мужик (m. noun, 'peasant; (coll.) man, guy'); indirect-object form.

начальники.analysis: Nominative pl. of начальник (m. noun, 'boss; chief; superior').

народов.analysis: Genitive pl. of народ (m. noun, 'people; nation; folk').

вежливый.analysis: Adjective, 'polite; courteous' (m. sg., nom.); comparative вежливее.

отличившихся.analysis: Gen./acc. pl. of past active participle of отличиться (perf., 'to distinguish oneself'); reflexive.

парни.analysis: Nominative pl. of парень (m. noun, 'guy; young man; lad'); fleeting vowel drops in plural.

поэту.analysis: Dative sg. of поэт (m. noun, 'poet'); indirect-object/recipient form.

результатах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of результат (m. noun, 'result; outcome'); used after о, в, на.

президенте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of президент (m. noun, 'president'); used after о, в, на.

усталого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m.-n. sg. of усталый (adj., 'tired; weary').

старику.analysis: Dative sg. of старик (m. noun, 'old man'); indirect-object/recipient form.

товарищем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of товарищ (m. noun, 'comrade; companion'); 'with/as a comrade'.

врачи.analysis: Nominative pl. of врач (m. noun, 'doctor; physician').

знакомому.analysis: Dative m.-n. sg. of знакомый (adj./n., 'familiar; acquaintance'); substantivized adjective.

заметку.analysis: Accusative sg. of заметка (f. noun, 'note; brief article'); nom. -ка becomes -ку.

подписать.analysis: Infinitive of подписать (perf., 'to sign; subscribe'); perfective of подписывать.

школьной.analysis: Gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. of школьный (adj., 'school-; scholastic').

информацию.analysis: Accusative sg. of информация (f. noun, 'information'); nom. -ия becomes -ию.

собирает.analysis: 3sg present of собирать (impf., 'to collect; gather; assemble'); imperfective of собрать.

придумали.analysis: Past pl. of придумать (perf., 'to invent; think up; devise'); perfective of придумывать.

журнала.analysis: Genitive sg. of журнал (m. noun, 'magazine; journal; log').

рассказы.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of рассказ (m. noun, 'story; short tale; account').

разговоров.analysis: Genitive pl. of разговор (m. noun, 'conversation; talk').

дар.analysis: Nominative sg. of дар (m. noun, 'gift; donation; innate talent').

телефонов.analysis: Genitive pl. of телефон (m. noun, 'telephone; phone').

перекрёстке.analysis: Prepositional sg. of перекрёсток (m. noun, 'crossroads; intersection'); fleeting -о- drops.

повторяется.analysis: 3sg present of повторяться (impf., 'to repeat; recur; be repeated'); reflexive -ся verb.

дорогих.analysis: Gen./prep./acc. pl. of дорогой (adj., 'expensive; dear; beloved'); comparative дороже.

классической.analysis: Gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. of классический (adj., 'classical; classic').

классическую.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of классический (adj., 'classical; classic').

науке.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of наука (f. noun, 'science; learning').

скрыта.analysis: Short f. sg. of past passive participle of скрыть (perf., 'to hide; conceal'); predicative.

опыту.analysis: Dative sg. of опыт (m. noun, 'experience; experiment'); indirect-object form.

большим.analysis: Instr. m.-n. sg. or dat. pl. of большой (adj., 'big; large'); suppletive comparative больше.

роли.analysis: Gen./dat./prep. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of роль (f. noun, 'role; part').

толстого.analysis: Gen./acc. m.-n. sg. of толстый (adj., 'fat; thick; stout'); comparative толще.

системы.analysis: Gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of система (f. noun, 'system').

образования.analysis: Gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of образование (n. noun, 'education; formation').

языку.analysis: Dative sg. of язык (m. noun, 'language; tongue'); indirect-object form.

разбил.analysis: Past m. sg. of разбить (perf., 'to break; smash; shatter'); perfective of разбивать.

напечатано.analysis: Short n. sg. past passive participle of напечатать (perf., 'to print/type'); predicative, 'it is printed'.

бабу.analysis: Accusative sg. of баба (f. noun, colloquial 'peasant woman/old woman'); direct-object form, -а becomes -у.

баб.analysis: Genitive pl. of баба (f. noun, colloquial 'peasant woman'); zero-ending plural form.

молитве.analysis: Dative or prepositional sg. of молитва (f. noun, 'prayer'); ending -а shifts to -е.

закончилось.analysis: Past n. sg. of закончиться (perf., reflexive, 'to come to an end'); signals a completed conclusion.

членов.analysis: Genitive pl. of член (m. noun, 'member'); used after numerals and quantity words.

девушку.analysis: Accusative sg. of девушка (f. noun, 'girl/young woman'); direct-object form, -а becomes -у.

совещании.analysis: Prepositional sg. of совещание (n. noun, 'meeting/conference'); ending -е becomes -и.

молодым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of молодой (adj., 'young'); also instrumental case of the noun phrase.

друге.analysis: Prepositional sg. of друг (m. noun, 'friend'); о друге, 'about a friend'.

наград.analysis: Genitive pl. of награда (f. noun, 'award/reward'); zero-ending plural form.

героем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of герой (m. noun, 'hero'); ending -ем after soft stem.

господину.analysis: Dative sg. of господин (m. noun, 'mister/gentleman'); recipient form, ending -у.

господам.analysis: Dative pl. of господин (m. noun, 'gentleman'); irregular plural stem господа, dative -ам.

остановила.analysis: Past f. sg. of остановить (perf., 'to stop/halt sth'); transitive, signals a completed act.

голосовали.analysis: Past pl. of голосовать (impf., 'to vote'); also means to hitchhike.

капитану.analysis: Dative sg. of капитан (m. noun, 'captain'); recipient form, ending -у.

капитанов.analysis: Genitive or accusative pl. of капитан (m. animate noun, 'captain'); ending -ов.

хозяевам.analysis: Dative pl. of хозяин (m. noun, 'owner/host/master'); irregular plural stem хозяева, dative -ам.

художников.analysis: Genitive or accusative pl. of художник (m. animate noun, 'artist/painter'); ending -ов.

командиров.analysis: Genitive or accusative pl. of командир (m. animate noun, 'commander'); ending -ов.

принадлежали.analysis: Past pl. of принадлежать (impf., 'to belong'); governs the dative of the possessor.

лейтенанты.analysis: Nominative pl. of лейтенант (m. noun, 'lieutenant'); subject form, ending -ы.

многих.analysis: Genitive/accusative/prepositional pl. of многий (adj./quantifier, 'many'); 'of many, about many'.

маленьких.analysis: Genitive/accusative/prepositional pl. of маленький (adj., 'small/little'); plural oblique form.

мужиком.analysis: Instrumental sg. of мужик (m. noun, colloquial 'peasant/bloke'); ending -ом.

начальников.analysis: Genitive or accusative pl. of начальник (m. animate noun, 'boss/chief'); ending -ов.

интересна.analysis: Short f. sg. of интересный (adj., 'interesting'); predicative, 'she/it is interesting'.

офицера.analysis: Genitive or accusative sg. of офицер (m. animate noun, 'officer'); ending -а.

офицеров.analysis: Genitive or accusative pl. of офицер (m. animate noun, 'officer'); ending -ов.

парней.analysis: Genitive or accusative pl. of парень (m. noun, 'guy/young man'); ending -ей after soft stem.

поэтом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of поэт (m. noun, 'poet'); ending -ом, e.g. 'to be a poet'.

началом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of начало (n. noun, 'beginning/start'); ending -ом.

президенты.analysis: Nominative pl. of президент (m. noun, 'president'); subject form, ending -ы.

солдата.analysis: Genitive or accusative sg. of солдат (m. animate noun, 'soldier'); ending -а.

стариком.analysis: Instrumental sg. of старик (m. noun, 'old man'); ending -ом.

товарище.analysis: Prepositional sg. of товарищ (m. noun, 'comrade/friend'); о товарище, 'about a comrade'.

спасают.analysis: 3pl present of спасать (impf., 'to save/rescue'); perfective is спасти.

знакомым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of знакомый (adj./noun, 'familiar/acquaintance').

важные.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of важный (adj., 'important'); plural attributive form.

документов.analysis: Genitive pl. of документ (m. noun, 'document'); ending -ов, used after quantity words.

газетой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of газета (f. noun, 'newspaper'); ending -ой.

пользователях.analysis: Prepositional pl. of пользователь (m. noun, 'user'); ending -ях after soft stem.

назвали.analysis: Past pl. of назвать (perf., 'to name/call'); signals a completed naming.

пользуюсь.analysis: 1sg present of пользоваться (impf., reflexive, 'to use/make use of'); governs the instrumental.

рассказов.analysis: Genitive pl. of рассказ (m. noun, 'short story/account'); ending -ов.

разговорам.analysis: Dative pl. of разговор (m. noun, 'conversation/talk'); ending -ам.

одному.analysis: Dative m./n. sg. of один (numeral/pron., 'one'); also adverbial 'on one's own'.

знака.analysis: Genitive or accusative sg. of знак (m. noun, 'sign/symbol/mark'); ending -а.

выиграли.analysis: Past pl. of выиграть (perf., 'to win'); signals a completed victory.

копия.analysis: Nominative sg. of копия (f. noun, 'copy/duplicate'); subject form.

дружный.analysis: Adjective (m. sg.), 'close-knit/harmonious'; describes a cohesive group.

литературой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of литература (f. noun, 'literature'); ending -ой.

занимается.analysis: 3sg present of заниматься (impf., reflexive, 'to be occupied with/study'); governs the instrumental.

печаль.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of печаль (f. noun, 'sorrow/grief'); soft-sign feminine.

справился.analysis: Past m. sg. of справиться (perf., reflexive, 'to cope/manage'); governs с + instrumental.

привёл.analysis: Past m. sg. of привести (perf., 'to bring/lead sb on foot'); signals a completed act.

режиссёр.analysis: Nominative sg. of режиссёр (m. noun, 'film/theatre director'); subject form.

романом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of роман (m. noun, 'novel'; also 'romance/affair'); ending -ом.

преимуществ.analysis: Genitive pl. of преимущество (n. noun, 'advantage'); zero-ending plural form.

статье.analysis: Dative or prepositional sg. of статья (f. noun, 'article/clause'); ending -е.

владею.natural: I own; I have command of.
владею.analysis: 1sg present of владеть (impf., 'to own/master'); governs the instrumental, e.g. a language.

рама.analysis: Nominative sg. of рама (f. noun, 'frame/window frame'); subject form.

обложке.analysis: Prepositional sg. of обложка (f. noun, 'cover/jacket of a book'); also dative form.

корзина.analysis: Nominative sg. of корзина (f. noun, 'basket'); also a recycle bin / shopping cart.

мужики.analysis: Nominative pl. of мужик (m. noun, 'peasant/guy'); colloquial for ordinary men.

боге.analysis: Prepositional sg. of бог (m. noun, 'god'); used after о/в, as in 'о боге'.

члена.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of член (m. noun, 'member'); animate sg. takes -а.

партии.analysis: Genitive/dative/prepositional sg. of партия (f. noun, 'party'); political or game sense.

девушки.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative pl. of девушка (f. noun, 'young woman/girl').

выступили.analysis: Past pl. of выступить (perf., 'to perform/come forward'); perfective of выступать.

доктором.analysis: Instrumental sg. of доктор (m. noun, 'doctor'); used with быть/работать or after с.

дурака.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of дурак (m. noun, 'fool'); animate, takes -а. Also the card game Дурак.

подчиняются.analysis: 3pl present of подчиняться (impf., 'to obey/submit'); reflexive -ся verb taking dative.

рассказывается.analysis: 3sg present of рассказываться (impf., 'to be told/narrated'); reflexive-passive of рассказывать.

меню.analysis: Indeclinable n. noun меню ('menu'); same in all cases. Restaurant or interface sense.

верно.analysis: Adverb / short n. adjective from верный ('true/correct'); also a particle meaning 'probably'.

гражданина.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of гражданин (m. noun, 'citizen'); animate, takes -а.

беспрекословно.analysis: Adverb from беспрекословный ('unquestioning'); describes obedience without objection.

отплытию.analysis: Dative sg. of отплытие (n. noun, 'setting sail/departure by ship'); from отплыть.

художника.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of художник (m. noun, 'artist'); animate, takes -а.

командира.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of командир (m. noun, 'commander'); animate, takes -а.

смелый.analysis: Adjective смелый ('brave', m. sg. nom.). Comparative смелее.

разным.analysis: Dative pl. or instrumental m./n. sg. of разный ('different/various').

совещание.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of совещание (n. noun, 'meeting/conference'); formal deliberation.

любимых.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. or animate accusative pl. of любимый ('favorite/beloved').

мужчину.analysis: Accusative sg. of мужчина (m. noun in -а, 'man'); animate object form, ending -а becomes -у.

мужике.analysis: Prepositional sg. of мужик (m. noun, 'peasant/guy'); colloquial register.

справедливый.analysis: Adjective справедливый ('just/fair', m. sg. nom.). Comparative справедливее.

немца.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of немец (m. noun, 'German man'); animate, fleeting -е- drops to -ца.

старшему.analysis: Dative m./n. sg. of старший ('elder/senior'); comparative-based adjective from старый.

награды.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of награда (f. noun, 'award/reward').

писателя.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of писатель (m. noun, 'writer'); animate soft-stem, takes -я.

поэте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of поэт (m. noun, 'poet'); used after о/в, as in 'о поэте'.

полковником.analysis: Instrumental sg. of полковник (m. noun, 'colonel'); used with быть or after с.

саммите.analysis: Prepositional sg. of саммит (m. noun, 'summit'); high-level political meeting.

солдату.analysis: Dative sg. of солдат (m. noun, 'soldier'); indirect-object form.

старике.analysis: Prepositional sg. of старик (m. noun, 'old man'); used after о/в.

товарищи.analysis: Nominative pl. of товарищ (m. noun, 'comrade/companion'); Soviet-era address.

опытных.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. or animate accusative pl. of опытный ('experienced').

знакомом.analysis: Prepositional m./n. sg. of знакомый ('familiar/acquaintance'); substantivized adjective.

секретарь.analysis: Nominative sg. of секретарь (m. noun, 'secretary'); soft sign ending, stressed final syllable.

фамилией.analysis: Instrumental sg. of фамилия (f. noun, 'surname/family name'); not 'family' (that is семья).

киоске.analysis: Prepositional sg. of киоск (m. noun, 'kiosk/news-stand'); used after в/о.

информации.analysis: Genitive/dative/prepositional sg. of информация (f. noun, 'information'); -ия declension.

карте.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of карта (f. noun, 'map/card'); also bank card.

смешным.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of смешной ('funny/ridiculous').

номером.analysis: Instrumental sg. of номер (m. noun, 'number' or 'hotel room'); also a performance act.

рассказам.analysis: Dative pl. of рассказ (m. noun, 'story/account'); also 'according to accounts' (по рассказам).

словом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of слово (n. noun, 'word'); also parenthetical 'in a word' (одним словом).

знаку.analysis: Dative sg. of знак (m. noun, 'sign/symbol/mark'); indirect-object form.

последнюю.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of последний ('last/latest'); soft-stem adjective.

посвятил.analysis: Past m. sg. of посвятить (perf., 'to dedicate/devote'); perfective of посвящать.

классу.analysis: Dative sg. of класс (m. noun, 'class/grade/classroom'); indirect-object form.

французской.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of французский ('French'); relational adjective.

музыке.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of музыка (f. noun, 'music'); used after к or в/о.

наукой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of наука (f. noun, 'science/scholarship'); used after с or with заниматься.

женские.analysis: Nominative/inanimate accusative pl. of женский ('women's/feminine'); relational adjective.

учёный.analysis: Nominative m. sg. of учёный (substantivized adjective, 'scientist/scholar'); also 'learned'.

примера.analysis: Genitive sg. of пример (m. noun, 'example'); as in 'например' (for example).

актёра.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of актёр (m. noun, 'actor'); animate, takes -а.

романе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of роман (m. noun, 'novel' or 'love affair'); used after о/в.

системе.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of система (f. noun, 'system'); used after к or в/о.

фактов.analysis: Genitive pl. of факт (m. noun, 'fact'); hard-stem, takes -ов.

английским.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of английский ('English'); relational adjective.

зеркала.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of зеркало (n. noun, 'mirror').

автору.analysis: Dative sg. of автор (m. noun, 'author'); indirect-object form, 'to the author'.

помогали.analysis: Past pl. of помогать (impf., 'to help'); takes dative object.

комитета.analysis: Genitive sg. of комитет (m. noun, 'committee'); 'of the committee'.

элегантная.analysis: Adjective элегантный ('elegant'), f. nom. sg. form.

девушке.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of девушка (f. noun, 'girl/young woman').

школ.analysis: Genitive pl. of школа (f. noun, 'school'); 'of schools'.

докторе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of доктор (m. noun, 'doctor'); 'about the doctor'.

глупого.analysis: Adjective глупый ('stupid/foolish'), m./n. genitive or m. animate accusative sg.

генералом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of генерал (m. noun, 'general'); 'with/by the general'.

герое.analysis: Prepositional sg. of герой (m. noun, 'hero'); 'about the hero'.

танцевала.analysis: Past f. sg. of танцевать (impf., 'to dance').

коллегами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of коллега (common-gender noun, 'colleague'); 'with colleagues'.

карт.analysis: Genitive pl. of карта (f. noun, 'card, map'); bare-stem form, e.g. колода карт.

проекту.analysis: Dative sg. of проект (m. noun, 'project, design, plan'); 'to/toward the project'.

рассказа.analysis: Genitive sg. of рассказ (m. noun, 'story, short story, account'); from рассказать.

разговору.analysis: Dative sg. of разговор (m. noun, 'conversation, talk'); from разговаривать.

политические.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of политический (adj., 'political'); from политика.

выучил.analysis: Past m. sg. of выучить (perf., 'to learn, memorize'); perfective of учить, stressing completion.

дорожных.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of дорожный (adj., 'road, traffic, travel-'); from дорога.

игр.analysis: Genitive pl. of игра (f. noun, 'game, play'); bare-stem form from игра.

изображён.analysis: Short past passive participle m. sg. of изобразить (perf., 'to depict, portray'); 'is depicted'.

литературу.analysis: Accusative sg. of литература (f. noun, 'literature'); direct-object form, -а becomes -у.

танцы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of танец (m. noun, 'dance'); fleeting vowel dropped in plural stem.

создал.analysis: Past m. sg. of создать (perf., 'to create, found'); perfective of создавать.

образах.analysis: Prepositional pl. of образ (m. noun, 'image, form, literary character'); note plural образа = icons.

опыте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of опыт (m. noun, 'experience, experiment'); after-preposition form.

полезные.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of полезный (adj., 'useful, beneficial'); from польза.

сыграл.analysis: Past m. sg. of сыграть (perf., 'to play' a game/role/piece); perfective of играть.

романов.analysis: Genitive pl. of роман (m. noun, 'novel; romance'); from роман.

систем.analysis: Genitive pl. of система (f. noun, 'system'); bare-stem form.

редактор.analysis: Nominative sg. of редактор (m. noun, 'editor'); also software editor.

европе.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of Европа (f. proper noun, 'Europe'); 'in Europe' with в.

зеркале.analysis: Prepositional sg. of зеркало (n. noun, 'mirror'); 'in the mirror' with в.

молодых.analysis: Genitive/accusative/prepositional pl. of молодой (adj., 'young'); hard-stem -ых ending.

разговаривал.analysis: Past m. sg. of разговаривать (impf., 'to talk/converse'); durative, ongoing past action.

бога.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of бог (m. noun, 'god'); animate, so acc. = gen. form.

многим.analysis: Dative pl. (or instrumental sg.) of много/многий ('many, much'); quantifier in oblique case.

члене.analysis: Prepositional sg. of член (m. noun, 'member'); also denotes a body part or grammatical term.

дамой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of дама (f. noun, 'lady'); also the queen card or dance partner.

сотрудники.analysis: Nominative pl. of сотрудник (m. noun, 'employee/colleague'); workplace co-worker.

хорошего.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of хороший (adj., 'good'); soft-stem -его ending after ш.

доверяют.analysis: 3pl present of доверять (impf., 'to trust'); governs the dative of the trusted party.

сломали.analysis: Past pl. of сломать (perf., 'to break'); perfective of ломать, a completed breaking.

генералы.analysis: Nominative pl. of генерал (m. noun, 'general'); top-ranking military officer.

героев.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of герой (m. noun, 'hero'); animate, so acc. = gen. plural.

швейцар.analysis: Nominative sg. of швейцар (m. noun, 'doorman/porter'); not to be confused with швейцарец.

гостю.analysis: Dative sg. of гость (m. noun, 'guest'); recipient form, 'to the guest'.

вежливо.analysis: Adverb of manner, from вежливый ('polite'); also short n. form of the adjective.

мостике.analysis: Prepositional sg. of мостик (m. noun, 'small bridge'); diminutive of мост.

кораблей.analysis: Genitive pl. of корабль (m. noun, 'ship'); soft-stem -ей plural ending.

хозяине.analysis: Prepositional sg. of хозяин (m. noun, 'host/owner/master'); pl. is хозяева.

выставке.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of выставка (f. noun, 'exhibition'); from выставлять.

командире.analysis: Prepositional sg. of командир (m. noun, 'commander'); military unit leader.

короле.analysis: Prepositional sg. of король (m. noun, 'king'); also the king card or chess piece.

лейтенанту.analysis: Dative sg. of лейтенант (m. noun, 'lieutenant'); junior military officer rank.

любимому.analysis: Dative m./n. sg. of любимый (adj., 'beloved/favorite'); from passive participle of любить.

мальчиком.analysis: Instrumental sg. of мальчик (m. noun, 'boy'); 'with/by a boy' or 'as a boy'.

мужчин.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of мужчина (m. noun, 'man'); animate, acc. = gen. plural.

начальнику.analysis: Dative sg. of начальник (m. noun, 'boss/superior'); 'to the boss'.

народе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of народ (m. noun, 'people/nation'); collective, denoting an ethnic or national group.

точность.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of точность (f. noun, 'accuracy/precision'); abstract -ость noun from точный.

офицере.analysis: Prepositional sg. of офицер (m. noun, 'officer'); commissioned military rank.

парню.analysis: Dative sg. of парень (m. noun, 'guy/young man/boyfriend'); fleeting vowel drops before -ю.

великого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of великий (adj., 'great'); -ого ending.

девятнадцатого.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of девятнадцатый (ordinal num., 'nineteenth'); used for dates.

президенту.analysis: Dative sg. of президент (m. noun, 'president'); 'to the president'.

профессоров.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of профессор (m. noun, 'professor'); nom. pl. is профессора.

соседе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of сосед (m. noun, 'neighbor'); soft-stem in plural (соседи).

старикам.analysis: Dative pl. of старик (m. noun, 'old man'); 'to the old men'.

женщиной.analysis: Instrumental sg. of женщина (f. noun, 'woman'); 'with/by a woman' or 'as a woman'.

накрыли.analysis: Past pl. of накрыть (perf., 'to cover/set the table'); perfective of накрывать.

документу.analysis: Dative sg. of документ (m. noun, 'document'); 'to/according to the document'.

одинаковые.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of одинаковый (adj., 'identical/same'); -ые plural ending.

имён.analysis: Genitive pl. of имя (n. noun, 'name'); -ен- stem extension typical of neuter -мя nouns.

распространяется.analysis: 3sg present of распространяться (impf., 'to spread/apply to'); reflexive -ся form.

зачитываюсь.analysis: 1sg present of зачитываться (impf., 'to be engrossed in reading'); reflexive -сь form.

номера.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative pl. of номер (m. noun, 'number/hotel room'); nom. pl. номера.

рассказу.analysis: Dative sg. of рассказ (m. noun, 'story/tale'); short prose narrative.

разговором.analysis: Instrumental sg. of разговор (m. noun, 'conversation/talk'); 'with/by a conversation'.

скучными.analysis: Instrumental pl. of скучный (adj., 'boring/dull'); -ыми plural instrumental ending.

телефоном.analysis: Instrumental sg. of телефон (m. noun, 'telephone'); 'by/with the phone'.

знаков.analysis: Genitive pl. of знак (m. noun, 'sign/symbol/mark'); 'of signs'.

травмировался.analysis: Past m. sg. of травмироваться (impf./perf., 'to be/get injured'); reflexive -ся form.

музее.analysis: Prepositional sg. of музей (m. noun, 'museum'); soft-stem -е ending after й.

учебника.analysis: Genitive sg. of учебник (m. noun, 'textbook'); from учить ('to teach/learn').

детской.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of детский (adj., 'children's'); also nominalized as 'nursery'.

напоминает.analysis: 3sg present of напоминать (impf., 'to remind/resemble'); governs dative of person reminded.

образа.analysis: Genitive sg. of образ (m. noun, 'image/way/icon'); also nom. pl. образы (images) vs. образа (icons).

новыми.analysis: Instrumental pl. of новый (adj., 'new'); -ыми plural instrumental ending.

опыты.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of опыт (m. noun, 'experiment'); sg. also means 'experience'.

примеры.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of пример (m. noun, 'example'); also a math problem.

ролей.analysis: Genitive pl. of роль (f. noun, 'role/part'); soft-stem -ей plural ending.

инженеры.analysis: Nominative pl. of инженер (m. noun, 'engineer'); 'the engineers'.

обновляет.analysis: 3sg present of обновлять (impf., 'to update/renew'); perfective is обновить.

статьями.analysis: Instrumental pl. of статья (f. noun, 'article'); soft-stem -ями plural ending.

языки.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of язык (m. noun, 'language/tongue'); 'languages or tongues'.

старинных.analysis: Gen./acc./prep. pl. of старинный (adj., 'ancient/antique'); of old objects or customs.

авторов.analysis: Genitive pl. of автор (m. noun, 'author'); also accusative pl. for the animate noun.

бабой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of баба (f. noun, 'peasant woman; old woman', colloquial). Can be coarse for 'woman'.

молится.analysis: 3sg present of молиться (impf., 'to pray'); reflexive verb, -ся ending.

богам.analysis: Dative pl. of бог (m. noun, 'god'); indirect-object form.

группы.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of группа (f. noun, 'group').

бал.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of бал (m. noun, 'ball, formal dance'). Homophone of балл ('point/grade').

директора.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of директор (m. noun, 'director'); also nominative pl. with stressed -а.

доктора.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of доктор (m. noun, 'doctor'); also nominative pl. with stressed -а.

докторам.analysis: Dative pl. of доктор (m. noun, 'doctor'); indirect-object form.

дураков.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of дурак (m. noun, 'fool'); animate, so accusative matches genitive.

генералов.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of генерал (m. noun, 'general'); animate, accusative matches genitive.

настоящих.analysis: Genitive/prepositional/accusative pl. of настоящий (adj., 'real, genuine, present').

поприветствовал.analysis: Past m. sg. of поприветствовать (perf., 'to greet'); perfective of приветствовать, completed act.

гостем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of гость (m. noun, 'guest'); soft-stem ending -ем.

честном.analysis: Prepositional m./n. sg. of честный (adj., 'honest, fair').

матросы.analysis: Nominative pl. of матрос (m. noun, 'sailor, seaman').

адмирал.analysis: Nominative sg. of адмирал (m. noun, 'admiral'); naval rank.

хозяева.analysis: Nominative pl. of хозяин (m. noun, 'owner, host, master'); irregular plural stem хозяев-.

художники.analysis: Nominative pl. of художник (m. noun, 'artist, painter').

базу.analysis: Accusative sg. of база (f. noun, 'base, depot'); nominative -а becomes -у.

короли.analysis: Nominative pl. of король (m. noun, 'king'); soft-stem plural.

обстановку.analysis: Accusative sg. of обстановка (f. noun, 'situation, atmosphere, furnishings'); -а becomes -у.

любимым.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of любимый (adj., 'beloved, favorite').

мальчике.analysis: Prepositional sg. of мальчик (m. noun, 'boy'); used after о/в/на.

мужика.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of мужик (m. noun, 'man, peasant', colloquial); animate.

начальником.analysis: Instrumental sg. of начальник (m. noun, 'boss, chief, superior').

регионе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of регион (m. noun, 'region'); used after в/о.

немцев.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of немец (m. noun, 'German'); animate, fleeting vowel dropped.

русские.analysis: Nominative pl. of русский (adj./noun, 'Russian'); substantivized adjective.

парнем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of парень (m. noun, 'guy, young man, boyfriend'); fleeting -е- dropped.

поэта.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of поэт (m. noun, 'poet'); animate.

полковника.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of полковник (m. noun, 'colonel'); animate military rank.

благодарны.analysis: Short-form pl. of благодарный (adj., 'grateful, thankful'); predicative use.

товарища.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of товарищ (m. noun, 'comrade, friend'); animate.

поговорил.analysis: Past m. sg. of поговорить (perf., 'to have a talk'); perfective of говорить, bounded act.

женщин.analysis: Genitive/accusative pl. of женщина (f. noun, 'woman'); animate, zero ending.

плотной.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of плотный (adj., 'dense, thick, tight').

вчерашней.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of вчерашний (adj., 'yesterday's'); from вчера.

редким.analysis: Instrumental m./n. sg. or dative pl. of редкий (adj., 'rare, sparse'). Comparative реже.

интернете.analysis: Prepositional sg. of интернет (m. noun, 'internet'); used after в.

точного.analysis: Genitive/accusative m./n. sg. of точный (adj., 'exact, precise, accurate').

номеру.analysis: Dative sg. of номер (m. noun, 'number, hotel room, issue'); indirect-object form.

рассказом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of рассказ (m. noun, 'story, short tale, account').

разговоре.analysis: Prepositional sg. of разговор (m. noun, 'conversation, talk'); used after о/в.

речей.analysis: Genitive pl. of речь (f. noun, 'speech, talk'); soft-stem plural.

телефоне.analysis: Prepositional sg. of телефон (m. noun, 'telephone'); used after о/в/на.

древней.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of древний (adj., 'ancient, old').

старинные.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of старинный (adj., 'antique, ancient, old').

развивались.analysis: Past pl. of развиваться (impf., 'to develop, evolve'); reflexive, -сь ending.

науку.analysis: Accusative sg. of наука (f. noun, 'science, scholarship'); -а becomes -у.

образу.analysis: Dative sg. of образ (m. noun, 'image, form, manner'); indirect-object form.

образами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of образ (m. noun, 'image, form, character').

проводят.analysis: 3pl present of проводить (impf., 'to conduct, hold, spend time, see off').

примеров.analysis: Genitive pl. of пример (m. noun, 'example, instance').

посвящён.analysis: Short-form m. sg. past passive of посвятить (perf., 'to dedicate, devote'); predicative.

создали.analysis: Past pl. of создать (perf., 'to create, found'); perfective, completed act.

статьях.analysis: Prepositional pl. of статья (f. noun, 'article, clause'); soft-stem.

зеркал.analysis: Genitive pl. of зеркало (n. noun, 'mirror'); zero ending with inserted vowel.

российская.analysis: Nom. f. sg. of российский (adj., 'Russian, of Russia'); relational adjective, refers to the state, not ethnicity (cf. русский).

бои.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of бой (m. noun, 'battle, combat, fight'). Related to бить, 'to beat'.

фронту.analysis: Dat. sg. of фронт (m. noun, 'front, frontline'); also the prepositional form is фронте.

группе.analysis: Dat./prep. sg. of группа (f. noun, 'group'); nominative ending -а becomes -е.

наблюдал.analysis: Past m. sg. of наблюдать (impf., 'to observe, watch'); governs за + instrumental.

приносят.analysis: 3pl present of приносить (impf., 'to bring'); perfective принести.

органе.analysis: Prep. sg. of орган (m. noun, 'organ, agency, body'); fixed stress, distinct from орга́н ('pipe organ').

критикует.analysis: 3sg present of критиковать (impf., 'to criticize'); perfective раскритиковать.

революций.analysis: Gen. pl. of революция (f. noun, 'revolution'); -ия nouns take -ий in genitive plural.

спортсмен.analysis: Nom. sg. of спортсмен (m. noun, 'athlete'); from спорт + -смен. Feminine спортсменка.

мудрости.analysis: Gen./dat./prep. sg. of мудрость (f. noun, 'wisdom'); abstract noun from мудрый, 'wise'.

справедливое.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of справедливый (adj., 'just, fair'); from справедливость, 'justice'.

борются.analysis: 3pl present of бороться (impf., 'to fight, struggle'); governs за/против + acc. or с + instrumental.

готовил.analysis: Past m. sg. of готовить (impf., 'to prepare, cook'); perfective приготовить.

добивался.analysis: Past m. sg. of добиваться (impf., 'to strive for, achieve'); reflexive, governs genitive; perfective добиться.

страшных.analysis: Gen./prep./acc. pl. of страшный (adj., 'terrible, frightening'); from страх, 'fear'.

нарушение.analysis: Nom./acc. sg. of нарушение (n. noun, 'violation, breach'); verbal noun from нарушать, 'to violate'.

терпела.analysis: Past f. sg. of терпеть (impf., 'to endure, tolerate'); perfective потерпеть.

правильного.analysis: Gen. m./n. sg. of правильный (adj., 'correct, right'); from правило, 'rule'. Adverb правильно.

полна.analysis: Short f. sg. of полный (adj., 'full'); predicative form, governs genitive (полна надежд).

лицу.analysis: Dat. sg. of лицо (n. noun, 'face; person'); also means grammatical person.

сны.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of сон (m. noun, 'dream; sleep'); fleeting vowel o drops in plural stem.

внезапный.analysis: Nom. m. sg. of внезапный (adj., 'sudden, abrupt'). Adverb внезапно.

сидишь.analysis: 2sg present of сидеть (impf., 'to sit, be sitting'); second-conjugation stative verb.

доставляет.analysis: 3sg present of доставлять (impf., 'to deliver; cause'); perfective доставить.

серьёзного.analysis: Gen. m./n. sg. of серьёзный (adj., 'serious'). Adverb серьёзно.

запаху.analysis: Dat. sg. of запах (m. noun, 'smell, scent, odor'). Related to пахнуть, 'to smell'.

радует.analysis: 3sg present of радовать (impf., 'to gladden, please'); from радость, 'joy'. Reflexive радоваться, 'to rejoice'.

руководствуется.analysis: 3sg present of руководствоваться (impf., 'to be guided by, follow'); reflexive, governs instrumental.

боевым.analysis: Instr. m./n. sg. or dat. pl. of боевой (adj., 'combat, fighting'); from бой, 'battle'.

спорту.analysis: Dat. sg. of спорт (m. noun, 'sport, sports'); typically singular-only.

надежды.analysis: Gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of надежда (f. noun, 'hope'). From надеяться, 'to hope'.

тайны.analysis: Gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of тайна (f. noun, 'secret, mystery'). Adjective тайный, 'secret'.

укрепили.analysis: Past pl. of укрепить (perf., 'to strengthen, reinforce'); imperfective укреплять. From крепкий, 'strong'.

волю.analysis: Acc. sg. of воля (f. noun, 'will, willpower; freedom'); nominative ending -я becomes -ю.

выражением.analysis: Instr. sg. of выражение (n. noun, 'expression'); verbal noun from выражать, 'to express'.

желания.analysis: Gen. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of желание (n. noun, 'desire, wish'); from желать, 'to wish'.

подходят.analysis: 3pl present of подходить (impf., 'to approach; be suitable'); perfective подойти.

неизвестно.analysis: Predicative/adverb form of неизвестный (adj., 'unknown'); used impersonally, 'it is not known'.

фактом.analysis: Instr. sg. of факт (m. noun, 'fact'). Adverb фактически, 'in fact'.

продукции.analysis: Gen./dat./prep. sg. of продукция (f. noun, 'production, output, goods'); -ия noun, collective sense.

увеличил.analysis: Past m. sg. of увеличить (perf., 'to increase, enlarge'); imperfective увеличивать.

мерой.analysis: Instr. sg. of мера (f. noun, 'measure, extent'); also 'measure' as an action taken.

яблока.analysis: Gen. sg. of яблоко (n. noun, 'apple'); nominative ending -о becomes -а.

описывает.analysis: 3sg present of описывать (impf., 'to describe'); perfective описать.

повода.analysis: Gen. sg. of повод (m. noun, 'reason, pretext, occasion'); often in без повода, 'without cause'.

непонятных.analysis: Gen./prep./acc. pl. of непонятный (adj., 'incomprehensible, unclear'); negated понятный.

шёпот.analysis: Nom./acc. sg. of шёпот (m. noun, 'whisper'). From шептать, 'to whisper'.

массовой.analysis: Gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. of массовый (adj., 'mass, large-scale'); from масса, 'mass'.

типов.analysis: Gen. pl. of тип (m. noun, 'type, kind'). Adjective типичный, 'typical'.

уровню.analysis: Dat. sg. of уровень (m. noun, 'level'); fleeting vowel e drops in oblique stem (уровня).

контракта.analysis: Gen. sg. of контракт (m. noun, 'contract'). Synonymous with договор.

явного.analysis: Gen. m./n. sg. of явный (adj., 'evident, obvious, overt'). Adverb явно.

профессия.analysis: Nom. sg. of профессия (f. noun, 'profession, occupation'); -ия declension.

вспоминает.analysis: 3sg present of вспоминать (impf., 'to recall, recollect'); perfective вспомнить.

плавные.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of плавный (adj., 'smooth, flowing, gradual'). Adverb плавно.

ходов.analysis: Gen. pl. of ход (m. noun, 'move, course, passage'); from ходить/идти.

положило.analysis: Past n. sg. of положить (perf., 'to put, lay'); imperfective класть. Suppletive aspect pair.

пожара.analysis: Gen. sg. of пожар (m. noun, 'fire, conflagration'); destructive blaze, distinct from огонь.

процессу.analysis: Dat. sg. of процесс (m. noun, 'process; trial'). Also means a legal proceeding.

способствуют.analysis: 3pl present of способствовать (impf., 'to promote, contribute to'); governs dative.

результате.analysis: Prep. sg. of результат (m. noun, 'result, outcome'); common in в результате, 'as a result'.

песке.analysis: Prep. sg. of песок (m. noun, 'sand'); fleeting vowel o drops in oblique stem (песка).

потрясены.analysis: Short pl. passive past participle of потрясти (perf., 'to shake, shock'); predicative, 'are shaken/shocked'.

мобильной.analysis: Gen./dat./instr./prep. f. sg. of мобильный (adj., 'mobile'); borrowing, used of phones and forces.

течении.analysis: Prep. sg. of течение (n. noun, 'flow, current, course'); common in в течении/в течение, 'during'.

перенёс.analysis: Past m. sg. of перенести (perf., 'to carry over, postpone; endure'); imperfective переносить.

армию.analysis: Accusative sg. of армия (f. noun, 'army'); direct-object form, nominative -я becomes -ю.

страшном.analysis: Prepositional (or m./n.) sg. of страшный (adj., 'terrible/frightening'); ending -ом marks m./n. prep. case.

фронтом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of фронт (m. noun, 'front, front line'); ending -ом marks the instrumental case.

староста.analysis: Nominative sg. of староста (m. noun by sense, 'village elder/group leader'); -а ending despite masculine reference.

обеими.analysis: Instrumental f. of обе (numeral 'both'); the feminine counterpart to masc./neut. оба, agreeing with two female/feminine items.

пользу.analysis: Accusative sg. of польза (f. noun, 'benefit, use'); common in в пользу ('in favour of').

эксперты.analysis: Nominative pl. of эксперт (m. noun, 'expert'); ending -ы marks the plural.

правительства.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of правительство (n. noun, 'government'); -а ending after the neuter stem.

французскую.analysis: Accusative f. sg. of французский (adj., 'French'); ending -ую marks f. acc. agreement.

заслужил.analysis: Past m. sg. of заслужить (perf., 'to deserve, earn'); signals a completed act of meriting something.

принял.analysis: Past m. sg. of принять (perf., 'to accept, receive'); perfective of принимать, marking a completed act.

решения.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of решение (n. noun, 'decision, solution'); -я ending after the soft neuter stem.

настоящей.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of настоящий (adj., 'real, genuine, present'); -ей ending marks f. oblique case.

ударов.analysis: Genitive pl. of удар (m. noun, 'blow, strike'); -ов ending marks the genitive plural.

обладает.analysis: 3sg present of обладать (impf., 'to possess'); takes an instrumental object (обладать чем-то).

врага.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of враг (m. animate noun, 'enemy'); -а ending marks the gen./acc. of an animate masculine.

закона.analysis: Genitive sg. of закон (m. noun, 'law'); -а ending marks the genitive case.

молчаливой.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of молчаливый (adj., 'silent, taciturn'); -ой ending marks f. oblique case.

лечения.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of лечение (n. noun, 'medical treatment'); -я ending after the soft neuter stem.

радостей.analysis: Genitive pl. of радость (f. noun, 'joy'); -ей ending marks the genitive plural of a soft-stem feminine.

слёз.analysis: Genitive pl. of слеза (f. noun, 'tear'); zero ending with stem vowel ё; e.g. до слёз ('to the point of tears').

снов.analysis: Genitive pl. of сон (m. noun, 'dream, sleep'); -ов ending, with fleeting vowel о dropping from the stem.

дрожала.analysis: Past f. sg. of дрожать (impf., 'to tremble, shake'); -ла marks feminine subject in the past tense.

отбрасывает.analysis: 3sg present of отбрасывать (impf., 'to cast, throw off'); imperfective of отбросить, e.g. casting a shadow.

удовольствия.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of удовольствие (n. noun, 'pleasure'); -я ending after the soft neuter stem.

заболевания.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of заболевание (n. noun, 'disease, illness'); -я ending after the soft neuter stem.

наполнился.analysis: Past m. sg. reflexive of наполниться (perf., 'to become full'); -ся marks the intransitive/reflexive sense.

звука.analysis: Genitive sg. of звук (m. noun, 'sound'); -а ending marks the genitive case.

чувством.analysis: Instrumental sg. of чувство (n. noun, 'feeling, sense'); -ом ending marks the instrumental case.

духом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of дух (m. noun, 'spirit'); -ом ending; e.g. пасть духом ('to lose heart').

отношусь.analysis: 1sg present reflexive of относиться (impf., 'to regard, treat'); takes к + dative, e.g. relating to someone.

цепляется.analysis: 3sg present reflexive of цепляться (impf., 'to cling, catch on'); takes за + accusative.

сознании.analysis: Prepositional sg. of сознание (n. noun, 'consciousness'); -ии ending after the soft neuter stem in -ие.

веру.analysis: Accusative sg. of вера (f. noun, 'faith, belief'); direct-object form, nominative -а becomes -у.

подчинился.analysis: Past m. sg. reflexive of подчиниться (perf., 'to obey, submit'); takes a dative object.

выражении.analysis: Prepositional sg. of выражение (n. noun, 'expression'); -ии ending after the soft neuter stem in -ие.

желанию.analysis: Dative sg. of желание (n. noun, 'wish, desire'); -ю ending after the soft neuter stem in -ие.

черту.analysis: Accusative sg. of черта (f. noun, 'feature, line'); nominative -а becomes -у; e.g. черту характера.

числу.analysis: Dative sg. of число (n. noun, 'number, date'); -у ending; e.g. к первому числу ('by the first').

научном.analysis: Prepositional (m./n.) sg. of научный (adj., 'scientific'); -ом ending marks m./n. prep. case.

добиваемся.analysis: 1pl present reflexive of добиваться (impf., 'to strive for, achieve'); takes a genitive object.

товаров.analysis: Genitive pl. of товар (m. noun, 'goods, merchandise'); -ов ending marks the genitive plural.

строгие.analysis: Nominative pl. of строгий (adj., 'strict, severe'); -ие ending marks the plural after a velar stem.

половины.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of половина (f. noun, 'half'); -ы ending after the hard stem.

основные.analysis: Nominative pl. of основной (adj., 'main, basic'); -ые ending marks the plural.

обрадовался.analysis: Past m. sg. reflexive of обрадоваться (perf., 'to become glad'); takes a dative object.

цен.analysis: Genitive pl. of цена (f. noun, 'price'); zero ending after the hard feminine stem.

ровным.analysis: Instrumental (m./n.) sg. of ровный (adj., 'even, smooth'); -ым ending marks m./n. instrumental.

юмор.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of юмор (m. noun, 'humor'); a zero-ending hard masculine.

почвы.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of почва (f. noun, 'soil, ground'); -ы ending after the hard stem.

немногие.analysis: Nominative pl. of немногий (adj./pron., 'few'); -ие ending; used substantively to mean 'few people'.

трудных.analysis: Genitive/prepositional pl. of трудный (adj., 'difficult'); -ых ending marks oblique plural.

принят.analysis: Short-form m. sg. past passive participle of принять (perf., 'to accept'); predicate use, e.g. закон принят.

правильным.analysis: Instrumental (m./n.) sg. of правильный (adj., 'correct, right'); -ым ending marks m./n. instrumental.

верен.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of верный (adj., 'faithful, true'); predicate use, e.g. он верен слову.

мышцы.analysis: Genitive sg. (or nom./acc. pl.) of мышца (f. noun, 'muscle'); -ы ending after the hard stem.

упусти.analysis: Imperative 2sg of упустить (perf., 'to miss, let slip'); often negated, e.g. не упусти шанс.

дружбе.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of дружба (f. noun, 'friendship'); -е ending marks dat./prep. case.

неизвестна.analysis: Short-form f. sg. of неизвестный (adj., 'unknown'); predicate use, e.g. причина неизвестна.

руководит.analysis: 3sg present of руководить (impf., 'to lead, direct'); takes an instrumental object.

развитию.analysis: Dative sg. of развитие (n. noun, 'development'); -ю ending after the soft neuter stem in -ие.

привело.analysis: Past n. sg. of привести (perf., 'to lead, bring'); -ло marks neuter subject; e.g. привело к беде.

следы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of след (m. noun, 'trace, footprint'); -ы ending marks the plural.

событием.analysis: Instrumental sg. of событие (n. noun, 'event'); -ем ending after the soft neuter stem in -ие.

дорожим.analysis: 1pl present of дорожить (impf., 'to value, cherish'); takes an instrumental object.

камней.analysis: Genitive pl. of камень (m. noun, 'stone'); -ей ending with fleeting vowel е dropping from the stem.

завтрашней.analysis: Genitive/dative/instr./prep. f. sg. of завтрашний (adj., 'tomorrow's'); -ей ending marks f. oblique case.

армией.analysis: Instrumental sg. of армия (f. noun, 'army'); object of an instrument or 'with/by' the army.

бое.analysis: Prepositional sg. of бой (m. noun, 'battle/fight'); used after в/о to mean 'in the battle'.

летели.analysis: Past pl. of лететь (impf., 'to fly' unidirectional); describes ongoing or repeated flight in the past.

помогаем.analysis: 1pl present of помогать (impf., 'to help'); governs the dative case of the person helped.

командами.analysis: Instrumental pl. of команда (f. noun, 'team; command'); 'with/by the teams or commands'.

обществу.analysis: Dative sg. of общество (n. noun, 'society'); indirect object, 'to/for society'.

печень.analysis: Nominative/accusative sg. of печень (f. noun, 'liver'); a soft-sign feminine noun, the bodily organ.

правительству.analysis: Dative sg. of правительство (n. noun, 'government'); indirect object, 'to/for the government'.

меняют.analysis: 3pl present of менять (impf., 'to change/exchange'); transitive, takes an accusative object.

славу.analysis: Accusative sg. of слава (f. noun, 'glory/fame'); direct-object form, ending -а becomes -у.

советы.analysis: Nominative/accusative pl. of совет (m. noun, 'advice; council'); plural of pieces of advice or bodies.

суда.analysis: Genitive sg. of суд (m. noun, 'court') or of судно ('ship/vessel'); 'of the court/vessel'.

свободе.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of свобода (f. noun, 'freedom'); used after в/о or as indirect object.

отбили.analysis: Past pl. of отбить (perf., 'to repel/beat off'); completed action, prefix от- adds 'away/back'.

огромной.analysis: Adjective огромный (f. sg. gen./dat./instr./prep.); agrees with a feminine noun, 'enormous'.

доверял.analysis: Past m. sg. of доверять (impf., 'to trust'); governs the dative of the trusted party.

подчиняться.analysis: Infinitive of подчиняться (impf., reflexive, 'to obey/submit'); governs the dative case.

болью.analysis: Instrumental sg. of боль (f. noun, 'pain'); soft-sign feminine, 'with/by pain'.

лечению.analysis: Dative sg. of лечение (n. noun, 'treatment/cure'); indirect object, 'to/toward treatment'.

простому.analysis: Adjective простой (m./n. sg. dat.); 'to the simple one', agrees with a dative masculine/neuter noun.

игрушкам.analysis: Dative pl. of игрушка (f. noun, 'toy'); indirect object, 'to/for the toys'.

погрузилась.analysis: Past f. sg. of погрузиться (perf., reflexive, 'to plunge/immerse oneself'); completed action.

страхом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of страх (m. noun, 'fear'); 'with/by fear', often after со.

спряталась.analysis: Past f. sg. of спрятаться (perf., reflexive, 'to hide oneself'); completed action.

кричали.analysis: Past pl. of кричать (impf., 'to shout/cry out'); ongoing or repeated past action.

заболевании.analysis: Prepositional sg. of заболевание (n. noun, 'illness/disease'); used after о/при.

запахом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of запах (m. noun, 'smell/scent'); 'with/by the smell'.

звуку.analysis: Dative sg. of звук (m. noun, 'sound'); indirect object, 'to/toward the sound'.

долга.analysis: Genitive sg. of долг (m. noun, 'duty; debt'); 'of duty/debt'. Homograph of f. short adj. долга ('long').

царит.analysis: 3sg present of царить (impf., 'to reign/prevail'); often of an atmosphere or mood.

защищаем.analysis: 1pl present of защищать (impf., 'to defend/protect'); transitive, takes an accusative object.

надеждой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of надежда (f. noun, 'hope'); 'with/by hope', often after с.

сознанием.analysis: Instrumental sg. of сознание (n. noun, 'consciousness/awareness'); 'with/by consciousness'.

вере.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of вера (f. noun, 'faith/belief'); used after в/о or as indirect object.

воле.analysis: Dative/prepositional sg. of воля (f. noun, 'will; freedom'); used after о/при or as indirect object.

ирония.analysis: Nominative sg. of ирония (f. noun, 'irony'); subject form, the rhetorical or situational sense.

желанием.analysis: Instrumental sg. of желание (n. noun, 'desire/wish'); 'with/by desire', often after с.

черты.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of черта (f. noun, 'line; feature/trait').

прибавьте.analysis: Imperative pl./polite of прибавить (perf., 'to add/increase'); a directed completed command.

факте.analysis: Prepositional sg. of факт (m. noun, 'fact'); used after о/в, 'about/in the fact'.

высокого.analysis: Adjective высокий (m./n. sg. gen./acc.); 'of the tall/high one', agrees with masc./neut. noun.

количества.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of количество (n. noun, 'quantity/amount').

вредным.analysis: Adjective вредный (m./n. sg. instr. or pl. dat.); 'with the harmful one', agrees with its noun.

согласны.analysis: Short-form pl. of adjective согласный ('agreeing/in accord'); predicate, 'they agree'.

материальное.analysis: Adjective материальный (n. sg. nom./acc.); agrees with a neuter noun, 'material/physical'.

любому.analysis: Pronoun/adjective любой (m./n. sg. dat.); 'to any one', agrees with masc./neut. dative noun.

экономического.analysis: Adjective экономический (m./n. sg. gen./acc.); 'of the economic one', agrees with its noun.

вызвало.analysis: Past n. sg. of вызвать (perf., 'to cause/summon/evoke'); completed action with a neuter subject.

средством.analysis: Instrumental sg. of средство (n. noun, 'means/remedy'); 'with/by the means'.

двигателя.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of двигатель (m. noun, 'engine/motor'); 'of the engine'.

уровнем.analysis: Instrumental sg. of уровень (m. noun, 'level'); 'with/by the level', fleeting -е- drops.

условиях.analysis: Prepositional pl. of условие (n. noun, 'condition/term'); used after в/при, 'in the conditions'.

большинством.analysis: Instrumental sg. of большинство (n. noun, 'majority'); 'by the majority', e.g. of votes.

опасное.analysis: Adjective опасный (n. sg. nom./acc.); agrees with a neuter noun, 'dangerous'.

детству.analysis: Dative sg. of детство (n. noun, 'childhood'); indirect object, 'to/toward childhood'.

слабеют.analysis: 3pl present of слабеть (impf., 'to grow weak/weaken'); intransitive, of a gradual decline.

момента.analysis: Genitive sg. of момент (m. noun, 'moment'); 'of the moment', e.g. after с ('since').

отношения.analysis: Genitive sg. or nominative/accusative pl. of отношение (n. noun, 'relation/attitude').

причин.analysis: Genitive pl. of причина (f. noun, 'reason/cause'); 'of the reasons', zero ending.

процессом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of процесс (m. noun, 'process'); 'with/by the process'.
